    30	/-- Numerical parameters for the low-degree game.  The ambient coefficient
    31	space uses the once-and-for-all model `fixedFieldModel P.q P.hq`, rather than a
    32	model supplied by each parameter record.  This is the Lean carrier for
    33	`def:ld-game` in
    34	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:17-105`, with paper origin
    35	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
    36	-/
    37	structure LdParams where
    38	  q : ℕ
    39	  m : ℕ
    40	  d : ℕ
    41	  k : ℕ
    42	  hm : 1 ≤ m
    43	  hd : 1 ≤ d
    44	  hk : 1 ≤ k
    45	  hq : IsAdmissibleSize q
    46	  hdvd : m ∣ q
    47	
    48	/-- The positive dimension in `LdParams` supplies the finite coordinate type
    49	used by the uniform axis and prefix-index marginals. -/
    50	instance (L : LdParams) : Nonempty (Fin L.m) :=
    51	  ⟨⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one L.hm⟩⟩
    52	
    53	/-- The fixed model accessor for an `LdParams` record.  It is a compatibility
    54	view of the global `fixedFieldModel` selector, not an independently quantified
    55	parameter.  Blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:17-31`; paper origin
    56	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
    57	-/
    58	noncomputable def LdParams.model (P : LdParams) : FixedFieldModel P.q :=
    59	  fixedFieldModel P.q P.hq
    60	
    61	/-- The scalar carrier selected by an `LdParams` record; this is the fixed
    62	field carrier in `def:ld-game`, selected globally by `LdParams.model`.
    63	Blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:17-31`, paper origin
    64	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
    65	-/
    66	abbrev ScalarQ (P : LdParams) := (P.model).K
    67	
    68	/-- The three low-degree question types of `def:ld-game`, blueprint
    69	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:17-31`, paper origin
    70	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
    71	-/
    72	inductive LdType where
    73	  | point
    74	  | aline
    75	  | dline
    76	  deriving DecidableEq, Repr, Inhabited, Fintype
    77	
    78	/-- The register index used by the low-degree game (`def:ld-game`, blueprint
    79	`ch13_qpbt_test.tex:17-31`; paper origin
    80	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`).
    81	-/
    82	abbrev LdIndex (P : LdParams) := (Fin P.m ⊕ Unit) ⊕ Fin P.m
    83	
    84	/-- The full ambient low-degree coefficient space (`def:ld-game`, blueprint
    85	`ch13_qpbt_test.tex:17-31`; paper origin
    86	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`).
    87	-/
    88	abbrev LdSpace (P : LdParams) := LdIndex P → ScalarQ P
    89	
    90	/-- The point coordinates of an ambient low-degree vector in
    91	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
    92	-/
    93	def LdSpace.point {P : LdParams} (z : LdSpace P) : Fin P.m → ScalarQ P :=
    94	  fun i => z (.inl (.inl i))
    95	
    96	/-- The shared scalar coordinate of an ambient low-degree vector in
    97	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
    98	-/
    99	def LdSpace.seed {P : LdParams} (z : LdSpace P) : ScalarQ P :=
   100	  z (.inl (.inr ()) )
   101	
   102	/-- The direction coordinates of an ambient low-degree vector in
   103	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
   104	-/
   105	def LdSpace.direction {P : LdParams} (z : LdSpace P) : Fin P.m → ScalarQ P :=
   106	  fun i => z (.inr i)
   107	
   108	/-- The integer-coordinate map `χ` from the fixed field representation.  This
   109	is `eq:chi-func` in `def:ld-question-distribution`, blueprint
   110	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:38-49`, paper origin
   111	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
   112	-/
   113	noncomputable def chiIndex (P : LdParams) (s : ScalarQ P) : Fin P.m := by
   114	  letI : NeZero P.m := ⟨by
   115	    exact Nat.ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one P.hm)⟩
   116	  exact Fin.ofNat P.m ((binaryRepresentation P.model s).val / (P.q / P.m))
   117	
   118	/-- The projection used in the diagonal-line map zeroes coordinates before the
   119	chosen index and retains the suffix of the direction vector.  This is the
   120	prefix restriction in `def:ld-question-distribution`, blueprint
   121	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:38-49`, paper origin
   122	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
   123	-/
   124	def prefixProjection {P : LdParams} (i : Fin P.m) (v : Fin P.m → ScalarQ P) :
   125	    Fin P.m → ScalarQ P :=
   126	  fun j => if j.val < i.val then 0 else v j
   127	
   128	/-- The point CL map, retaining the point block and clearing the auxiliary
   129	blocks.  It is the map `L_point` of `def:ld-question-distribution`, blueprint
   130	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:38-49`, paper origin
   131	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
   132	-/
   133	def ldPointCL (P : LdParams) (z : LdSpace P) : LdSpace P :=
   134	  fun i => match i with
   135	  | .inl (.inl j) => z (.inl (.inl j))
   136	  | .inl (.inr _) => 0
   137	  | .inr _ => 0
   138	
   139	/-- The affine-line CL map.  The direction block is put through the canonical
   140	line representative map from `def:line-representative`, while the point block
   141	is retained (blueprint `blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:38-49`; paper
   142	origin `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`).
   143	-/
   144	noncomputable def ldALineCL (P : LdParams) (z : LdSpace P) : LdSpace P :=
   145	  let i := chiIndex P (z.seed)
   146	  let rep := lineRepMap (coordinateDirection i)
   147	  fun i => match i with
   148	  | .inl (.inl j) => (rep (z.point)) j
   149	  | .inl (.inr _) => z (.inl (.inr ()))
   150	  | .inr _ => 0
   151	
   152	/-- The diagonal-line CL map, using the same canonical representative interface
   153	for the direction block.  This is the `L_DLine` clause of
   154	`def:ld-question-distribution` (blueprint
   155	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:38-49`; paper origin
   156	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`).
   157	-/
   158	noncomputable def ldDLineCL (P : LdParams) (z : LdSpace P) : LdSpace P :=
   159	  let i := chiIndex P (z.seed)
   160	  let direction := prefixProjection i (z.direction)
   161	  let rep := lineRepMap direction
   162	  fun i => match i with
   163	  | .inl (.inl j) => (rep (z.point)) j
   164	  | .inl (.inr _) => z (.inl (.inr ()))
   165	  | .inr j => direction j
   166	
   167	/-- Dispatch the three low-degree CL maps by question type.  This is the typed
   168	construction in `def:ld-question-distribution`, blueprint
   169	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:38-49`, paper origin
   170	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
   171	-/
   172	noncomputable def ldCL (P : LdParams) : LdType → LdSpace P → LdSpace P
   173	  | .point => ldPointCL P
   174	  | .aline => ldALineCL P
   175	  | .dline => ldDLineCL P
   176	
   177	/-- The conditional-linearity level of the affine-line map.  This is a named
   178	Lean proof obligation for the prose assertion in `def:ld-question-distribution`,
   179	blueprint `blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:38-49`, paper
   180	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
   181	-/
   182	theorem isCondLinear_ldALineCL (P : LdParams) :
   183	    IsCondLinearOn (ScalarQ P) Finset.univ 2 (ldALineCL P) := by
   184	  sorry
   185	
   186	/-- The conditional-linearity level of the diagonal-line map.  This is the
   187	level-3 assertion in `def:ld-question-distribution`, blueprint
   188	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:38-49`, paper origin
   189	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
   190	-/
   191	theorem isCondLinear_ldDLineCL (P : LdParams) :
   192	    IsCondLinearOn (ScalarQ P) Finset.univ 3 (ldDLineCL P) := by
   193	  sorry
   194	
   195	/-- The question alphabet for the low-degree game (`def:ld-game`, blueprint
   196	`ch13_qpbt_test.tex:17-31`; paper origin
   197	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`).
   198	-/
   199	abbrev LdQuestion (P : LdParams) := LdType × LdSpace P
   200	
   201	/-- The typed CL question distribution.  This is the inlined construction in
   202	`def:ld-question-distribution`, blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:38-49`; paper
   203	origin `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
   204	-/
   205	noncomputable def ldQuestionDistribution (P : LdParams) :
   206	    Distribution (LdQuestion P × LdQuestion P) :=
   207	  Distribution.map
   208	    (uniformDistribution ((LdType × LdType) × LdSpace P))
   209	    (fun s =>
   210	      ((s.1.1, ldCL P s.1.1 s.2), (s.1.2, ldCL P s.1.2 s.2)))
   211	
   212	/-- The coefficient-tuple answer alphabet of the low-degree game.  Polynomial
   213	answers are representatives with exactly the coefficient lengths printed in
   214	the paper, as required by `def:ld-win-predicate` (blueprint
   215	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:56-105`; paper
   216	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`).
   217	-/
   218	inductive LdAnswer (P : LdParams) where
   219	  | pointVals (a : Fin P.k → ScalarQ P)
   220	  | alinePolys (a : Fin P.k → Fin (P.d + 1) → ScalarQ P)
   221	  | dlinePolys (a : Fin P.k → Fin (P.m * P.d + 1) → ScalarQ P)
   222	  deriving DecidableEq
   223	
   224	/-- A finite sum code used only to provide the answer alphabet's `Fintype`
   225	instance; the public constructors are those of `def:ld-win-predicate`,
   226	blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:56-105`, paper origin
   227	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
   228	-/
   229	abbrev LdAnswerCode (P : LdParams) :=
   230	  (Fin P.k → ScalarQ P) ⊕
   231	    ((Fin P.k → Fin (P.d + 1) → ScalarQ P) ⊕
   232	      (Fin P.k → Fin (P.m * P.d + 1) → ScalarQ P))
   233	
   234	/-- The constructor-preserving code equivalence for `LdAnswer` (Lean-only
   235	finite-carrier infrastructure for `def:ld-win-predicate`, blueprint
   236	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:56-105`, paper origin
   237	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`).
   238	-/
   239	noncomputable def ldAnswerEquiv (P : LdParams) :
   240	    LdAnswer P ≃ LdAnswerCode P where
   241	  toFun
   242	    | .pointVals a => .inl a
   243	    | .alinePolys a => .inr (.inl a)
   244	    | .dlinePolys a => .inr (.inr a)
   245	  invFun
   246	    | .inl a => .pointVals a
   247	    | .inr (.inl a) => .alinePolys a
   248	    | .inr (.inr a) => .dlinePolys a
   249	  left_inv := by intro x; cases x <;> rfl
   250	  right_inv := by
   251	    intro x
   252	    cases x with
   253	    | inl a => rfl
   254	    | inr x =>
   255	        cases x with
   256	        | inl a => rfl
   257	        | inr a => rfl
   258	
   259	instance (P : LdParams) : Inhabited (LdAnswer P) :=
   260	  ⟨.pointVals (fun _ => 0)⟩
   261	
   262	noncomputable instance (P : LdParams) : Fintype (LdAnswer P) :=
   263	  Fintype.ofEquiv (LdAnswerCode P) (ldAnswerEquiv P).symm
   264	
   265	/-- Evaluation of a coefficient tuple at a field element.  This is the
   266	representative convention used by the line answers in `def:ld-win-predicate`,
   267	blueprint `blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:56-105`, paper origin
   268	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
   269	-/
   270	def evalCoefficient {K : Type*} [Semiring K] {n : ℕ}
   271	    (c : Fin n → K) (t : K) : K :=
   272	  ∑ i : Fin n, c i * t ^ i.val
   273	
   274	/-- Check that an answer has the constructor prescribed by its question type;
   275	Lean encoding of the rejection clause in `def:ld-win-predicate`, blueprint
   276	`ch13_qpbt_test.tex:56-105`, paper origin
   277	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
   278	-/
   279	def validLdAnswer {P : LdParams} (t : LdType) (a : LdAnswer P) : Bool :=
   280	  match t, a with
   281	  | .point, .pointVals _ => true
   282	  | .aline, .alinePolys _ => true
   283	  | .dline, .dlinePolys _ => true
   284	  | _, _ => false
   285	
   286	/-- The axis-parallel line/point relation in `def:ld-win-predicate`, blueprint
   287	`ch13_qpbt_test.tex:56-105`, paper origin
   288	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
   289	-/
   290	def alinePointCondition (P : LdParams) (line point : LdSpace P)
   291	    (f : Fin P.k → Fin (P.d + 1) → ScalarQ P)
   292	    (a : Fin P.k → ScalarQ P) : Prop :=
   293	  -- Universal quantification follows the zero-direction convention in
   294	  -- `rem:ld-win-zero-direction`.
   295	  ∀ t : ScalarQ P,
   296	    point.point = line.point + t • coordinateDirection (chiIndex P line.seed) →
   297	      ∀ j : Fin P.k, evalCoefficient (f j) t = a j
   298	
   299	/-- The diagonal line/point relation in `def:ld-win-predicate`, blueprint
   300	`ch13_qpbt_test.tex:56-105`, paper origin
   301	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
   302	-/
   303	def dlinePointCondition (P : LdParams) (line point : LdSpace P)
   304	    (f : Fin P.k → Fin (P.m * P.d + 1) → ScalarQ P)
   305	    (a : Fin P.k → ScalarQ P) : Prop :=
   306	  ∀ t : ScalarQ P,
   307	    point.point = line.point + t • line.direction →
   308	      ∀ j : Fin P.k, evalCoefficient (f j) t = a j
   309	
   310	/-- The low-degree consistency predicate, rejecting answers of the wrong
   311	constructor shape.  This is `def:ld-win-predicate` in
   312	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:56-105`, paper origin
   313	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
   314	-/
   315	noncomputable def ldWinPredicate (P : LdParams) :
   316	    LdQuestion P → LdQuestion P → LdAnswer P → LdAnswer P → Bool :=
   317	  open Classical in
   318	  fun (tA, xA) (tB, xB) a b =>
   319	      if validLdAnswer tA a && validLdAnswer tB b then
   320	        match tA, tB, a, b with
   321	        | .point, .point, .pointVals u, .pointVals v => decide (u = v)
   322	        | .aline, .point, .alinePolys f, .pointVals u =>
   323	            decide (alinePointCondition P xA xB f u)
   324	        | .point, .aline, .pointVals u, .alinePolys f =>
   325	            decide (alinePointCondition P xB xA f u)
   326	        | .dline, .point, .dlinePolys f, .pointVals u =>
   327	            decide (dlinePointCondition P xA xB f u)
   328	        | .point, .dline, .pointVals u, .dlinePolys f =>
   329	            decide (dlinePointCondition P xB xA f u)
   330	        | .aline, .aline, .alinePolys f, .alinePolys g => decide (f = g)
   331	        | .dline, .dline, .dlinePolys f, .dlinePolys g => decide (f = g)
   332	        | _, _, _, _ => true
   333	      else false
   334	
   335	/-- The low-degree game packaged as a `Game`.  This is `def:ld-game` in
   336	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:17-105`, paper origin
   337	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
   338	-/
   339	noncomputable def ldGame (P : LdParams) : Game where
   340	  QuestionA := LdQuestion P
   341	  QuestionB := LdQuestion P
   342	  AnswerA := LdAnswer P
   343	  AnswerB := LdAnswer P
   344	  μ := ldQuestionDistribution P
   345	  μ_prob := by sorry
   346	  decide := ldWinPredicate P
   347	
   348	end
   349	
   350	end MIPStarRE.QPBT

     6	
     7	This file provides the finite game carrier used by the Pauli basis test.  Pure

     9	`Measurement` structure.

    15	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:47-82` and `8-26`.

    25	
    26	/--
    27	A finite two-player one-round game with a probability distribution on question
    28	pairs and a Boolean decision predicate.  This is `def:game` in
    29	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:51-59`, with paper origin
    30	`references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:10-24`.
    31	-/
    32	structure Game where
    33	  QuestionA : Type
    34	  QuestionB : Type
    35	  AnswerA : Type
    36	  AnswerB : Type

    27	/-- Coefficient lists for a univariate polynomial of degree at most `c` in the

    30	  Fin (c + 1) → DirectScalarQ D
    31	
    32	/-- A direct line polynomial evaluates to `a` at `u` when `u` lies on the line
    33	and every parameter presenting `u` gives value `a`.  The universal clause
    34	keeps the zero-direction case explicit. -/
    35	def DirectEvaluatesTo {D : DirectLdParams} {c : ℕ} (line : DirectLineDesc D)
    36	    (f : DirectDegPoly D c) (u : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D)
    37	    (a : DirectScalarQ D) : Prop :=
    38	  (∃ t : DirectScalarQ D, u = line.base + t • line.direction) ∧
    39	    ∀ t : DirectScalarQ D, u = line.base + t • line.direction →
    40	      evalCoefficient f t = a

    42	/-- Option-completed evaluation of a direct line polynomial.  `none` is an
    43	explicit outcome when the point does not determine an evaluation; no field
    44	value is used as a fallback. -/
    45	noncomputable def directEvalOpt {D : DirectLdParams} {c : ℕ}
    46	    (line : DirectLineDesc D) (u : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D)
    47	    (f : DirectDegPoly D c) : Option (DirectScalarQ D) := by
    48	  classical
    49	  exact if h : ∃ a : DirectScalarQ D, DirectEvaluatesTo line f u a then
    50	    some (Classical.choose h)
    51	  else none

    98	its finite code. -/
    99	noncomputable def directLdAnswerEquiv (D : DirectLdParams) :
   100	    DirectLdAnswer D ≃ DirectLdAnswerCode D where
   101	  toFun
   102	    | .pointVals a => .inl a
   103	    | .alinePolys a => .inr (.inl a)
   104	    | .dlinePolys a => .inr (.inr a)
   105	  invFun
   106	    | .inl a => .pointVals a
   107	    | .inr (.inl a) => .alinePolys a
   108	    | .inr (.inr a) => .dlinePolys a
   109	  left_inv := by intro answer; cases answer <;> rfl
   110	  right_inv := by
   111	    intro answer
   112	    rcases answer with a | a
   113	    · rfl
   114	    · rcases a with a | a <;> rfl
   115	
   116	instance (D : DirectLdParams) : Inhabited (DirectLdAnswer D) :=
   117	  ⟨.pointVals 0⟩
   118	
   119	noncomputable instance (D : DirectLdParams) : Fintype (DirectLdAnswer D) :=
   120	  Fintype.ofEquiv (DirectLdAnswerCode D) (directLdAnswerEquiv D).symm
   121	
   122	/-- Check that a direct-game answer has the constructor required by its
   123	question type. -/
   124	def validDirectLdAnswer {D : DirectLdParams} (t : LdType)
   125	    (answer : DirectLdAnswer D) : Bool :=
   126	  match t, answer with
   127	  | .point, .pointVals _ => true
   128	  | .aline, .alinePolys _ => true
   129	  | .dline, .dlinePolys _ => true
   130	  | _, _ => false
   131	
   132	/-- The directly indexed axis-line versus point acceptance relation. -/
   133	def directAlinePointCondition (D : DirectLdParams)
   134	    (line point : DirectLdSpace D)
   135	    (f : Fin D.k → Fin (D.d + 1) → DirectScalarQ D)
   136	    (a : Fin D.k → DirectScalarQ D) : Prop :=
   137	  ∀ t : DirectScalarQ D,
   138	    point.point = line.point + t • coordinateDirection line.index →
   139	      ∀ j : Fin D.k, evalCoefficient (f j) t = a j
   140	
   141	/-- The directly indexed diagonal-line versus point acceptance relation. -/
   142	def directDlinePointCondition (D : DirectLdParams)
   143	    (line point : DirectLdSpace D)
   144	    (f : Fin D.k → Fin (D.m * D.d + 1) → DirectScalarQ D)
   145	    (a : Fin D.k → DirectScalarQ D) : Prop :=
   146	  ∀ t : DirectScalarQ D,
   147	    point.point = line.point + t • line.direction →
   148	      ∀ j : Fin D.k, evalCoefficient (f j) t = a j
   149	
   150	/-- The directly indexed low-degree win predicate.  It differs from
   151	`ldWinPredicate` only by reading the coordinate index directly from each line
   152	question. -/
   153	noncomputable def directLdWinPredicate (D : DirectLdParams) :
   154	    DirectLdQuestion D → DirectLdQuestion D →
   155	      DirectLdAnswer D → DirectLdAnswer D → Bool :=
   156	  open Classical in
   157	  fun (tA, xA) (tB, xB) a b =>
   158	    if validDirectLdAnswer tA a && validDirectLdAnswer tB b then
   159	      match tA, tB, a, b with
   160	      | .point, .point, .pointVals u, .pointVals v => decide (u = v)
   161	      | .aline, .point, .alinePolys f, .pointVals u =>
   162	          decide (directAlinePointCondition D xA xB f u)
   163	      | .point, .aline, .pointVals u, .alinePolys f =>
   164	          decide (directAlinePointCondition D xB xA f u)
   165	      | .dline, .point, .dlinePolys f, .pointVals u =>
   166	          decide (directDlinePointCondition D xA xB f u)
   167	      | .point, .dline, .pointVals u, .dlinePolys f =>
   168	          decide (directDlinePointCondition D xB xA f u)
   169	      | .aline, .aline, .alinePolys f, .alinePolys g => decide (f = g)
   170	      | .dline, .dline, .dlinePolys f, .dlinePolys g => decide (f = g)
   171	      | _, _, _, _ => true
   172	    else false
   173	
   174	/-- The directly indexed low-degree game at an arbitrary positive dimension.
   175	It is an internal analysis game, not the conditionally linear verifier game
   176	`ldGame`. -/
   177	noncomputable def directLdGame (D : DirectLdParams) : Game where
   178	  QuestionA := DirectLdQuestion D
   179	  QuestionB := DirectLdQuestion D
   180	  AnswerA := DirectLdAnswer D
   181	  AnswerB := DirectLdAnswer D
   182	  μ := directLdQuestionDistribution D
   183	  μ_prob := directLdQuestionDistribution_isProbability D
   184	  decide := directLdWinPredicate D
   185	
   186	/-- The canonical point question associated with a geometric point. -/
   187	def directLdPointQuestionOf (D : DirectLdParams)
   188	    (u : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) : DirectLdQuestion D :=
   189	  (.point, ⟨u, D.firstIndex, 0⟩)
   190	
   191	/-- Total point-answer relabeling used in the direct soundness conclusion.
   192	Wrong-form answers are folded into the zero tuple, exactly as for
   193	`ldPointValuesOrZero`. -/
   194	def directLdPointValuesOrZero (D : DirectLdParams) :
   195	    DirectLdAnswer D → Fin D.k → DirectScalarQ D
   196	  | .pointVals values => values
   197	  | .alinePolys _ => 0
   198	  | .dlinePolys _ => 0
   199	
   200	/-- A simultaneous tuple of bounded polynomials for the directly indexed
   201	game. -/
   202	noncomputable abbrev DirectPolyTuple (D : DirectLdParams) :=
   203	  Fin D.k → PolyIndex D.m (DirectScalarQ D) D.d
   204	
   205	/-- A polynomial-tuple POVM for the directly indexed game. -/
   206	noncomputable abbrev DirectPolyMeasTuple (D : DirectLdParams) (ι : Type*)
   207	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] :=
   208	  Measurement (DirectPolyTuple D) ι
   209	
   210	/-- Evaluate every component of a direct polynomial tuple at a point. -/
   211	def evalDirectPolyTupleAt {D : DirectLdParams}
   212	    (u : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) (g : DirectPolyTuple D) :
   213	    Fin D.k → DirectScalarQ D :=
   214	  fun j => MvPolynomial.eval u (g j).1
   215	
   216	end
   217	
   218	end MIPStarRE.QPBT

     4	/-!
     5	# Rejection probabilities for the directly indexed low-degree game
     6	
     7	This module compares the rejection probability of the directly indexed game
     8	with the branch weights used by the mature low-individual-degree test.
     9	All declarations below are formalization-only support derived from the game
    10	value; none is a paper-labelled result.
    11	
    12	## References
    13	
    14	The uniform distribution on the three ordered question types is specified in
    15	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:178-186`,
    16	and its verifier is specified in the same file at lines 320-392.  The mature
    17	low-individual-degree test's three equal outer weights and its uniform role
    18	choices are specified in `references/ldt-paper/test_definition.tex:10-67`.
    19	-/
    20	
    21	open scoped BigOperators MatrixOrder Matrix ComplexOrder

    26	open MIPStarRE.Quantum

    30	private theorem directLdAccepted_add_rejected_eq_one
    31	    (D : DirectLdParams) (S : Strategy (directLdGame D))
    32	    (types : LdType × LdType) (sample : DirectLdSpace D) :
    33	    (∑ a : (directLdGame D).AnswerA, ∑ b : (directLdGame D).AnswerB,
    34	        if directLdWinPredicate D
    35	            (types.1, directLdMap D types.1 sample)
    36	            (types.2, directLdMap D types.2 sample) a b then
    37	          outcomeWeight S
    38	            (types.1, directLdMap D types.1 sample)
    39	            (types.2, directLdMap D types.2 sample) a b
    40	        else 0) +
    41	      (∑ a : (directLdGame D).AnswerA, ∑ b : (directLdGame D).AnswerB,
    42	        if directLdWinPredicate D
    43	            (types.1, directLdMap D types.1 sample)
    44	            (types.2, directLdMap D types.2 sample) a b then
    45	          0
    46	        else outcomeWeight S
    47	          (types.1, directLdMap D types.1 sample)
    48	          (types.2, directLdMap D types.2 sample) a b) = 1 := by
    49	  calc
    50	    _ = ∑ a : (directLdGame D).AnswerA, ∑ b : (directLdGame D).AnswerB,
    51	        outcomeWeight S
    52	          (types.1, directLdMap D types.1 sample)
    53	          (types.2, directLdMap D types.2 sample) a b := by
    54	      rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    55	      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    56	      intro a _
    57	      rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    58	      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    59	      intro b _
    60	      by_cases h : directLdWinPredicate D
    61	          (types.1, directLdMap D types.1 sample)
    62	          (types.2, directLdMap D types.2 sample) a b
    63	      · simp [h]
    64	      · simp [h]
    65	    _ = 1 := outcomeWeight_sum_eq_one S
    66	      (types.1, directLdMap D types.1 sample)
    67	      (types.2, directLdMap D types.2 sample)

    69	/-- Rejection probability conditioned on an ordered pair of low-degree
    70	question types, averaged over the common direct sample. -/
    71	noncomputable def directLdBranchRejectionProbability
    72	    (D : DirectLdParams) (S : Strategy (directLdGame D))
    73	    (types : LdType × LdType) : ℝ :=
    74	  avgOver (uniformDistribution (DirectLdSpace D)) fun sample =>
    75	    ∑ a : (directLdGame D).AnswerA, ∑ b : (directLdGame D).AnswerB,
    76	      if directLdWinPredicate D
    77	          (types.1, directLdMap D types.1 sample)
    78	          (types.2, directLdMap D types.2 sample) a b then
    79	        0
    80	      else outcomeWeight S
    81	        (types.1, directLdMap D types.1 sample)
    82	        (types.2, directLdMap D types.2 sample) a b
    83	
    84	/-- Total rejection probability of the directly indexed low-degree game,
    85	averaged uniformly over its nine ordered type branches. -/
    86	noncomputable def directLdRejectionProbability
    87	    (D : DirectLdParams) (S : Strategy (directLdGame D)) : ℝ :=
    88	  avgOver (uniformDistribution (LdType × LdType))
    89	    (directLdBranchRejectionProbability D S)
    90	
    91	/-- The branch failure probability with the weights used by the mature
    92	low-individual-degree test. -/
    93	noncomputable def directLdLdtWeightedFailureProbability
    94	    (D : DirectLdParams) (S : Strategy (directLdGame D)) : ℝ :=
    95	  let B := directLdBranchRejectionProbability D S
    96	  ((B (.aline, .point) + B (.point, .aline)) / 2 +
    97	      B (.point, .point) +
    98	      (B (.dline, .point) + B (.point, .dline)) / 2) / 3

   100	private theorem sum_ldType (f : LdType → ℝ) :
   101	    ∑ t : LdType, f t = f .point + f .aline + f .dline := by
   102	  change (Finset.univ : Finset LdType).sum f = _
   103	  rw [show (Finset.univ : Finset LdType) = {.point, .aline, .dline} by decide]
   104	  simp [add_assoc]
   105	
   106	private theorem avgOver_ldType_pair (f : LdType × LdType → ℝ) :
   107	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (LdType × LdType)) f =
   108	      (f (.point, .point) + f (.point, .aline) + f (.point, .dline) +
   109	        (f (.aline, .point) + f (.aline, .aline) + f (.aline, .dline)) +
   110	        (f (.dline, .point) + f (.dline, .aline) + f (.dline, .dline))) / 9 := by
   111	  unfold avgOver uniformDistribution Distribution.uniformOnFinset
   112	  simp only [Finset.mem_univ, if_true, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_prod]
   113	  rw [show Fintype.card LdType = 3 by decide]
   114	  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
   115	  simp_rw [sum_ldType]
   116	  ring

   118	/-- Every fixed-type rejection probability is nonnegative. -/
   119	theorem directLdBranchRejectionProbability_nonneg
   120	    (D : DirectLdParams) (S : Strategy (directLdGame D))
   121	    (types : LdType × LdType) :
   122	    0 ≤ directLdBranchRejectionProbability D S types := by
   123	  apply avgOver_nonneg
   124	  intro sample
   125	  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
   126	  intro a _
   127	  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
   128	  intro b _
   129	  by_cases h : directLdWinPredicate D
   130	      (types.1, directLdMap D types.1 sample)
   131	      (types.2, directLdMap D types.2 sample) a b
   132	  · simp [h]
   133	  · simpa [h] using outcomeWeight_nonneg S
   134	      (types.1, directLdMap D types.1 sample)
   135	      (types.2, directLdMap D types.2 sample) a b
   136	
   137	/-- Total direct-game rejection is one minus the strategy value. -/
   138	theorem directLdRejectionProbability_eq_one_sub_value
   139	    (D : DirectLdParams) (S : Strategy (directLdGame D)) :
   140	    directLdRejectionProbability D S = 1 - S.value := by
   141	  let accepted : (LdType × LdType) → DirectLdSpace D → ℝ :=
   142	    fun types sample =>
   143	      ∑ a : (directLdGame D).AnswerA, ∑ b : (directLdGame D).AnswerB,
   144	        if directLdWinPredicate D
   145	            (types.1, directLdMap D types.1 sample)
   146	            (types.2, directLdMap D types.2 sample) a b then
   147	          outcomeWeight S
   148	            (types.1, directLdMap D types.1 sample)
   149	            (types.2, directLdMap D types.2 sample) a b
   150	        else 0
   151	  have hbranch (types : LdType × LdType) :
   152	      directLdBranchRejectionProbability D S types =
   153	        1 - avgOver (uniformDistribution (DirectLdSpace D)) (accepted types) := by
   154	    rw [show directLdBranchRejectionProbability D S types =
   155	        avgOver (uniformDistribution (DirectLdSpace D))
   156	          (fun sample => 1 - accepted types sample) by
   157	      apply avgOver_congr
   158	      intro sample
   159	      dsimp [accepted]
   160	      linarith [directLdAccepted_add_rejected_eq_one D S types sample]]
   161	    rw [avgOver_sub, avgOver_uniform_const]
   162	  rw [show directLdRejectionProbability D S =
   163	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (LdType × LdType))
   164	        (fun types => 1 -
   165	          avgOver (uniformDistribution (DirectLdSpace D)) (accepted types)) by
   166	    unfold directLdRejectionProbability
   167	    apply avgOver_congr
   168	    exact hbranch]
   169	  rw [avgOver_sub, avgOver_uniform_const]
   170	  congr 1
   171	  rw [Strategy.value]
   172	  symm
   173	  change avgOver (directLdQuestionDistribution D) _ = _
   174	  rw [directLdQuestionDistribution, Distribution.avgOver_map]
   175	  exact avgOver_uniform_prod (f := accepted)

   177	/-- The mature low-individual-degree branch weighting is at most three times
   178	the uniformly weighted direct-game rejection probability. -/
   179	theorem directLdLdtWeightedFailureProbability_le_three_mul_rejection
   180	    (D : DirectLdParams) (S : Strategy (directLdGame D)) :
   181	    directLdLdtWeightedFailureProbability D S ≤
   182	      3 * directLdRejectionProbability D S := by
   183	  have hnonneg := directLdBranchRejectionProbability_nonneg D S
   184	  have hpp := hnonneg (.point, .point)
   185	  have hpa := hnonneg (.point, .aline)
   186	  have hpd := hnonneg (.point, .dline)
   187	  have hap := hnonneg (.aline, .point)
   188	  have haa := hnonneg (.aline, .aline)
   189	  have had := hnonneg (.aline, .dline)
   190	  have hdp := hnonneg (.dline, .point)
   191	  have hda := hnonneg (.dline, .aline)
   192	  have hdd := hnonneg (.dline, .dline)
   193	  rw [directLdRejectionProbability, avgOver_ldType_pair]
   194	  unfold directLdLdtWeightedFailureProbability
   195	  dsimp only
   196	  linarith

   198	/-- A strategy with value at least `1 - ε` has mature-LDT-weighted failure
   199	probability at most `3 * ε`. -/
   200	theorem directLdLdtWeightedFailureProbability_le_three_mul_error
   201	    (D : DirectLdParams) (S : Strategy (directLdGame D))
   202	    (ε : ℝ) (hwin : 1 - ε ≤ S.value) :
   203	    directLdLdtWeightedFailureProbability D S ≤ 3 * ε := by
   204	  have hrejection : directLdRejectionProbability D S ≤ ε := by
   205	    rw [directLdRejectionProbability_eq_one_sub_value]
   206	    linarith
   207	  calc
   208	    directLdLdtWeightedFailureProbability D S ≤
   209	        3 * directLdRejectionProbability D S :=
   210	      directLdLdtWeightedFailureProbability_le_three_mul_rejection D S
   211	    _ ≤ 3 * ε := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hrejection (by norm_num)
   212

   421	/-- Point-agreement defect at a mature point is at most the rejected direct
   422	mass at the direct point question. -/
   423	private theorem point_defect_le (u : Point D.toLDTParameters) :
   424	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   425	    qBipartiteConsDefect (directCoordinateProjStrat D S hS r).state
   426	        ((directCoordinateProjStrat D S hS r).pointMeasurementA u).toSubMeas
   427	        ((directCoordinateProjStrat D S hS r).pointMeasurementB u).toSubMeas ≤
   428	      directRejectedMass D S
   429	        (directLdPointQuestionOf D (ldtPointToDirect D u))
   430	        (directLdPointQuestionOf D (ldtPointToDirect D u)) := by
   431	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   432	  exact qBipartiteConsDefect_le_directRejectedMass D S hS
   433	    (directPointQuestionOf D u) (directPointQuestionOf D u)
   434	    (directPointAnswerReadout D r) (directPointAnswerReadout D r)
   435	    (fun a b hab =>
   436	      directPointAnswerReadout_eq_of_win D r (ldtPointToDirect D u) a b hab)

   438	/-- The point-agreement failure of the coordinate strategy is at most the

   441	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel

   445	  unfold ProjStrat.pointAgreementFailureProbability bipartiteConsError
   446	  refine le_trans (avgOver_mono _ _ _ fun u => point_defect_le D S hS r u)
   447	    (le_of_eq ?_)
   448	  rw [directLdBranchRejectionProbability_eq_avgOver]
   449	  let f : (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) → ℝ := fun p =>
   450	    directRejectedMass D S (directLdPointQuestionOf D p) (directLdPointQuestionOf D p)
   451	  calc
   452	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Point D.toLDTParameters))
   453	        (fun u => f (ldtPointToDirect D u)) =
   454	        avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D)) f :=
   455	      (avgOver_uniform_equiv (directPointEquiv D) f).symm
   456	    _ = avgOver (uniformDistribution ((Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) × Fin D.m))
   457	        (fun pi => f pi.1) :=

   462	    _ = _ := by
   463	      apply avgOver_congr
   464	      intro sample
   465	      rfl

   481	    (directAxisQuestionOf D ⟨s.1, s.2⟩) (directPointQuestionOf D s.1)

     5	/-!
     6	# Branch comparison for the coordinate strategies of the direct low-degree game
     7	
     8	Every branch of the mature low individual degree failure probability of a
     9	coordinate strategy `directCoordinateProjStrat` is compared with the ordered
    10	type-pair branch of the direct game asking the same questions.  An accepted
    11	direct answer pair reads out to equal mature answers: the line answer, rebased
    12	to the mature line and evaluated at the mature base point, is the point
    13	answer, and the zero-direction convention reads the constant value at the base
    14	point.  Hence the mature inconsistency mass at a question pair is at most the
    15	rejected direct Born mass there.  The point-agreement and axis-line branches
    16	then compare exactly after the coordinate reindexing of `directPointEquiv`;
    17	the diagonal branches are treated in `Transport.DiagonalRecursion`.
    18

    21	- `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:214-458`

    44	/-- The Born mass of the rejected answer pairs at a fixed pair of direct

    47	def directRejectedMass (D : DirectLdParams) (S : Strategy (directLdGame D))
    48	    (x y : DirectLdQuestion D) : ℝ :=
    49	  ∑ a : DirectLdAnswer D, ∑ b : DirectLdAnswer D,
    50	    if directLdWinPredicate D x y a b then 0 else outcomeWeight S x y a b

    54	    0 ≤ directRejectedMass D S x y := by
    55	  refine Finset.sum_nonneg fun a _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun b _ => ?_
    56	  split_ifs
    57	  · exact le_rfl
    58	  · exact outcomeWeight_nonneg S x y a b

   130	        simp only [Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
   131	        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
   132	        intro b _
   133	        by_cases hab : readA a = readB b
   134	        · simp [hab]
   135	        · have hba : ¬ readB b = readA a := fun h => hab h.symm
   136	          simp [hab, hba]
   137	  have hone : ∑ a : DirectLdAnswer D, ∑ b : DirectLdAnswer D,
   138	      outcomeWeight S x y a b = 1 :=
   139	    outcomeWeight_sum_eq_one S x y
   140	  have htotal :
   141	      ev (strategyQuantumState S)
   142	        (opTensor
   143	          (ProjMeas.postprocess
   144	            (matrixMeasurementToLDTProjMeas (S.A x) (hS.1 x)) readA).toSubMeas.total
   145	          (ProjMeas.postprocess
   146	            (matrixMeasurementToLDTProjMeas (S.B y) (hS.2 y)) readB).toSubMeas.total) =
   147	        1 := by
   148	    change ev (strategyQuantumState S)
   149	      (Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun x1 x2 => x1 * x2) (1 : Op S.ιA) (1 : Op S.ιB)) = 1

   154	  rw [htotal, hmatch, ← hone, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
   155	  unfold directRejectedMass
   156	  refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun a _ => ?_
   157	  rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
   158	  refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun b _ => ?_
   159	  have hw := outcomeWeight_nonneg S x y a b
   160	  by_cases hacc : directLdWinPredicate D x y a b = true
   161	  · have hread := hwin a b hacc
   162	    simp [hacc, hread]

   166	/-! ## Accepted answer pairs read out consistently
   167	
   168	An accepted answer pair of the direct game consists of well-formed answers
   169	satisfying the line-versus-point clause or the consistency clause of
   170	`def:ld-win-predicate`.  The readouts of `Transport.Questions` evaluate the
   171	rebased line polynomial at the mature base point, which is the direct point
   172	at the canonical rebase parameter; the accepted clause forces this value to
   173	be the point answer.  Zero directions use the constant readout at the base
   174	point, where the universal clause of `rem:ld-win-zero-direction` gives the
   175	value at parameter zero. -/
   176	
   177	/-- On the point-agreement branch, an accepted pair of point answers has
   178	equal readouts in every simultaneous coordinate. -/
   179	theorem directPointAnswerReadout_eq_of_win (D : DirectLdParams) (r : Fin D.k)
   180	    (p : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) (a b : DirectLdAnswer D)
   181	    (hwin : directLdWinPredicate D (directLdPointQuestionOf D p)
   182	      (directLdPointQuestionOf D p) a b = true) :
   183	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   184	    directPointAnswerReadout D r a = directPointAnswerReadout D r b := by
   185	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   186	  cases a with
   187	  | pointVals u =>
   188	      cases b with
   189	      | pointVals v =>
   190	          have huv : u = v := by
   191	            simpa [directLdWinPredicate, directLdPointQuestionOf,
   192	              validDirectLdAnswer] using hwin
   193	          subst huv
   194	          rfl
   195	      | alinePolys _ =>
   196	          simp [directLdWinPredicate, directLdPointQuestionOf,
   197	            validDirectLdAnswer] at hwin
   198	      | dlinePolys _ =>
   199	          simp [directLdWinPredicate, directLdPointQuestionOf,
   200	            validDirectLdAnswer] at hwin
   201	  | alinePolys _ =>
   202	      simp [directLdWinPredicate, directLdPointQuestionOf,
   203	        validDirectLdAnswer] at hwin
   204	  | dlinePolys _ =>
   205	      simp [directLdWinPredicate, directLdPointQuestionOf,
   206	        validDirectLdAnswer] at hwin

     4	/-!
     5	# Strategy transport for the directly indexed low-degree game
     6	
     7	This module reads one coordinate of a projective directly indexed strategy as
     8	a two-space mature low individual degree strategy.  The question and answer
     9	transport of `Transport.Questions` supplies the canonical direct question of
    10	every mature line, with the reversed coordinate order and the leading index
    11	of the decoded diagonal direction, together with answer readouts that are
    12	covariant under line rebasing; this establishes all four covariance
    13	conditions of `ProjStrat`.  The module also records exact Born-weight
    14	formulas for both directions of strategy transport.

    16	## References

    18	- `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-458`
    19	- `references/ldt-paper/test_definition.tex:49-151`
    20	- `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex`
    21	-/

    40	    MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjMeas alpha iota where

   113	/-- The coordinate axis-line family is independent of the chosen affine
   114	parametrization of a mature line. -/
   115	theorem directCoordinateAxisMeasurement_reparam
   116	    (D : DirectLdParams) (r : Fin D.k)
   117	    {iota : Type*} [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
   118	    (M : DirectLdQuestion D →
   119	      MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (DirectLdAnswer D) iota)
   120	    (hM : ∀ q, MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (M q)) :
   121	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   122	    AxisParallelMeasurementReparamInvariant D.toLDTParameters
   123	      (directCoordinateAxisMeasurement D r M hM) := by
   124	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   125	  classical
   126	  intro line t f
   127	  simp only [directCoordinateAxisMeasurement, ProjMeas.postprocess,
   128	    SubMeas.postprocess_outcome, matrixMeasurementToLDTProjMeas_outcome]
   129	  rw [directAxisQuestionOf_rebase]
   130	  have hfiber :
   131	      Finset.univ.filter (fun answer =>
   132	        directAxisAnswerReadout D r (line.rebaseAt t) answer =
   133	          AxisLinePolynomial.reparamAt f t) =
   134	        Finset.univ.filter (fun answer =>
   135	          directAxisAnswerReadout D r line answer = f) := by
   136	    ext answer
   137	    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
   138	    rw [directAxisAnswerReadout_rebase]
   139	    exact (AxisLinePolynomial.reparamAtEquiv t).injective.eq_iff
   140	  rw [hfiber]

   324	    ev (strategyQuantumState S) (opTensor A B) =
   325	      vectorBornWeight S.ψ A B := by

   328	      PureState.toQuantumState (strategyPureState S) by
   329	        simp [strategyQuantumState],
   330	    PureState.ev_eq_re_inner]
   331	  unfold vectorBornWeight vectorBornAmplitude applyOperatorToState heteroKron opTensor

   338	/-- Postprocessing both local measurements gives the exact double sum of the
   339	original Born weights over the two answer fibers. -/
   340	theorem directPostprocessBornWeight
   341	    (D : DirectLdParams) (S : Strategy (directLdGame D))
   342	    (hS : S.IsProjective)
   343	    {alpha beta : Type*} [Fintype alpha] [DecidableEq alpha]
   344	    [Fintype beta] [DecidableEq beta]
   345	    (x y : DirectLdQuestion D)
   346	    (readA : DirectLdAnswer D → alpha)
   347	    (readB : DirectLdAnswer D → beta)
   348	    (a : alpha) (b : beta) :
   349	    ev (strategyQuantumState S)
   350	        (opTensor
   351	          ((ProjMeas.postprocess
   352	            (matrixMeasurementToLDTProjMeas (S.A x) (hS.1 x)) readA).outcome a)
   353	          ((ProjMeas.postprocess
   354	            (matrixMeasurementToLDTProjMeas (S.B y) (hS.2 y)) readB).outcome b)) =
   355	      ∑ directA ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun answer => readA answer = a),
   356	        ∑ directB ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun answer => readB answer = b),
   357	          outcomeWeight S x y directA directB := by
   358	  rw [strategyQuantumState_ev_eq_vectorBornWeight]
   359	  simp only [ProjMeas.postprocess, SubMeas.postprocess_outcome,
   360	    matrixMeasurementToLDTProjMeas_outcome]
   361	  rw [vectorBornWeight_finset_sum_left]
   362	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   363	  intro directA _
   364	  rw [vectorBornWeight_finset_sum_right]
   365	  rfl

   367	/-- Correlated residue registers turn two block-diagonal effects into the
   368	uniform average of their matching source-block Born weights. -/
   369	private theorem seedFiberBlockBornAmplitude
   370	    {G : Game} (S : Strategy G) (L : LdParams)
   371	    (A : Fin (L.q / L.m) → Op S.ιA)
   372	    (B : Fin (L.q / L.m) → Op S.ιB) :
   373	    vectorBornAmplitude (seedFiberLiftedState S L)
   374	        (Matrix.blockDiagonal A) (Matrix.blockDiagonal B) =
   375	      (Fintype.card (Fin (L.q / L.m)) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
   376	        ∑ residue, vectorBornAmplitude S.ψ (A residue) (B residue) := by
   377	  classical
   378	  letI : Nonempty (Fin (L.q / L.m)) :=
   379	    Fin.pos_iff_nonempty.mp L.seedFiberCard_pos
   380	  unfold vectorBornAmplitude applyOperatorToState heteroKron Matrix.kronecker
   381	  simp_rw [EuclideanSpace.inner_eq_star_dotProduct]
   382	  simp only [Matrix.toEuclideanLin, Matrix.toLpLin_apply,
   383	    dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec]
   384	  simp_rw [← Finset.univ_product_univ, Finset.sum_product]
   385	  simp [seedFiberLiftedState_apply, Matrix.blockDiagonal_apply,
   386	    mul_assoc, mul_comm]
   387	  ring_nf
   388	  simp_rw [mul_assoc, ← Finset.mul_sum]
   389	  ring_nf
   390	  simp_rw [mul_assoc, ← Finset.mul_sum]
   391	  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
   392	  rw [← mul_assoc]
   393	  congr 1
   394	  rw [← pow_two, inv_pow, ← Complex.ofReal_pow,
   395	    Real.sq_sqrt (Nat.cast_nonneg (L.q / L.m))]
   396	  norm_cast
   397	  exact Complex.ofReal_inv _

   399	/-- Correlated residue registers give the uniform average of the source-block
   400	Born weights. -/
   401	private theorem seedFiberBlockBornWeight
   402	    {G : Game} (S : Strategy G) (L : LdParams)
   403	    (A : Fin (L.q / L.m) → Op S.ιA)
   404	    (B : Fin (L.q / L.m) → Op S.ιB) :
   405	    vectorBornWeight (seedFiberLiftedState S L)
   406	        (Matrix.blockDiagonal A) (Matrix.blockDiagonal B) =
   407	      (Fintype.card (Fin (L.q / L.m)) : ℝ)⁻¹ *
   408	        ∑ residue, vectorBornWeight S.ψ (A residue) (B residue) := by
   409	  unfold vectorBornWeight
   410	  rw [seedFiberBlockBornAmplitude]
   411	  simp [Complex.mul_re, Complex.inv_re, Complex.inv_im]

   413	/-- The Born weight of the seed-bearing direct adapter is the uniform average
   414	of the original seed-dependent Born weights over the correlated residue. -/
   415	theorem ldStrategyToDirect_bornWeight
   416	    (L : LdParams) (S : Strategy (ldGame L))
   417	    (x y : DirectLdQuestion L.toDirectLdParams)
   418	    (a b : DirectLdAnswer L.toDirectLdParams) :
   419	    outcomeWeight (ldStrategyToDirect L S) x y a b =
   420	      (Fintype.card (Fin (L.q / L.m)) : ℝ)⁻¹ *
   421	        ∑ residue,
   422	          outcomeWeight S
   423	            (seededLdQuestion L x residue)
   424	            (seededLdQuestion L y residue)
   425	            ((ldDirectAnswerEquiv L).symm a)
   426	            ((ldDirectAnswerEquiv L).symm b) := by
   427	  change vectorBornWeight (seedFiberLiftedState S L)
   428	      (Matrix.blockDiagonal fun residue =>
   429	        (S.A (seededLdQuestion L x residue)).effect
   430	          ((ldDirectAnswerEquiv L).symm a))
   431	      (Matrix.blockDiagonal fun residue =>
   432	        (S.B (seededLdQuestion L y residue)).effect
   433	          ((ldDirectAnswerEquiv L).symm b)) = _
   434	  exact seedFiberBlockBornWeight S L _ _

    18	/-- Trace-based failure surrogate for the axis-parallel lines test.
    19	Point answers on the left register, line answers (evaluated at the
    20	base point) on the right register of the bipartite state. -/
    21	noncomputable def axisParallelFailureProbability
    22	    {params : Parameters} [FieldModel params.q]
    23	    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    24	    (strategy : SymStrat params ι) : Error :=
    25	  bipartiteConsError strategy.state
    26	    (uniformDistribution (AxisParallelTestSample params))
    27	    (axisParallelPointAnswerFamily strategy)
    28	    (axisParallelLineAnswerFamily strategy)
    29	
    30	/-- Trace-based failure surrogate for the self-consistency test.
    31	Uses bipartite SSC defect (cross-register overlap).
    32	For projective measurements this equals `bipartiteConsError`
    33	between the same measurement on both registers. -/
    34	noncomputable def selfConsistencyFailureProbability
    35	    {params : Parameters} [FieldModel params.q]
    36	    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    37	    (strategy : SymStrat params ι) : Error :=
    38	  bipartiteSSCError strategy.state
    39	    (uniformDistribution (Point params))
    40	    (IdxProjMeas.toIdxSubMeas strategy.pointMeasurement)
    41	
    42	/-- Trace-based failure surrogate for the diagonal lines test.
    43	Averages over the restriction index `j ∈ {0, …, m − 1}`, then
    44	over the `j`-restricted diagonal test. For each `j`, direction
    45	vectors have the last `m − j − 1` coordinates equal to zero. -/
    46	noncomputable def diagonalFailureProbability
    47	    {params : Parameters} [FieldModel params.q]
    48	    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    49	    (strategy : SymStrat params ι) : Error :=
    50	  -- `params.hm : 0 < params.m` ensures the averaging denominator is nonzero.
    51	  (1 / (params.m : Error)) *
    52	    ∑ j : Fin params.m,
    53	      bipartiteConsError strategy.state
    54	        (uniformDistribution
    55	          (RestrictedDiagonalSample params j))
    56	        (diagonalPointAnswerFamily strategy j)
    57	        (diagonalLineAnswerFamily strategy j)
    58	
    59	/-- The paper's notion of an `(ε,δ,γ)`-good symmetric strategy.
    60	
    61	Matches the paper's Definition 3.1: three test-passing bounds with no
    62	extra hypotheses.  The reparametrization covariance that was formerly
    63	listed here is now a structural property of `SymStrat`, where it
    64	belongs (the paper treats diagonal measurements as geometrically
    65	covariant by construction). -/
    66	structure IsGood {params : Parameters} {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    67	    [FieldModel params.q]
    68	    (strategy : SymStrat params ι)
    69	    (eps delta gamma : Error) : Prop where
    70	  axisParallelTest : strategy.axisParallelFailureProbability ≤ eps
    71	  selfConsistencyTest : strategy.selfConsistencyFailureProbability ≤ delta
    72	  diagonalLineTest : strategy.diagonalFailureProbability ≤ gamma
    73	
    74	end SymStrat

    76	/-- The diagonal-line failure surrogate is nonnegative. -/
    77	theorem diagonalFailureProbability_nonneg
    78	    (params : Parameters) [FieldModel params.q]
    79	    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    80	    (strategy : SymStrat params ι) :
    81	    0 ≤ strategy.diagonalFailureProbability := by
    82	  unfold SymStrat.diagonalFailureProbability
    83	  refine mul_nonneg ?_ ?_
    84	  · positivity
    85	  · refine Finset.sum_nonneg ?_
    86	    intro j _
    87	    exact bipartiteConsError_nonneg strategy.state
    88	      (uniformDistribution (RestrictedDiagonalSample params j))
    89	      (diagonalPointAnswerFamily strategy j)
    90	      (diagonalLineAnswerFamily strategy j)

   107	    hgood.axisParallelTest

    21	/-- Direct-sum measurement obtained by placing Alice's and Bob's complete
    22	measurements on the `Sum.inl` and `Sum.inr` sectors respectively. -/
    23	noncomputable def localDirectSumMeasurement {Outcome ιA ιB : Type*}
    24	    [Fintype Outcome] [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
    25	    (MA : Measurement Outcome ιA) (MB : Measurement Outcome ιB) :
    26	    Measurement Outcome (LocalCarrierSum ιA ιB) :=
    27	  ({ outcome := fun a => localDirectSumBlock (MA.outcome a) (MB.outcome a)
    28	     total := localDirectSumBlock MA.total MB.total
    29	     outcome_pos := fun a => localDirectSumBlock_nonneg (MA.outcome_pos a) (MB.outcome_pos a)
    30	     sum_eq_total :=
    31	       (localDirectSumBlock_finset_sum Finset.univ MA.outcome MB.outcome).trans
    32	         (congrArg₂ localDirectSumBlock MA.sum_eq_total MB.sum_eq_total)
    33	     total_le_one :=
    34	       ((congrArg₂ localDirectSumBlock MA.total_eq_one MB.total_eq_one).trans
    35	         localDirectSumBlock_one).le } :
    36	    SubMeas Outcome (LocalCarrierSum ιA ιB)).toMeasurement
    37	    ((congrArg₂ localDirectSumBlock MA.total_eq_one MB.total_eq_one).trans
    38	      localDirectSumBlock_one)

   100	/-- Role-register projective measurement obtained by block-diagonalizing two
   101	complete direct-sum projective measurements. -/
   102	noncomputable def roleBlockProjMeas {Outcome ιA ιB : Type*}
   103	    [Fintype Outcome] [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
   104	    (MA MB : ProjMeas Outcome (LocalCarrierSum ιA ιB)) :
   105	    ProjMeas Outcome (RoleRegisterLocal ιA ιB) where
   106	  toMeasurement := roleBlockMeasurement MA.toMeasurement MB.toMeasurement
   107	  proj := fun a =>
   108	    (roleBlock_mul _ _ _ _).trans (congrArg₂ roleBlock (MA.proj a) (MB.proj a))

   112	    (MA MB : ProjMeas Outcome (LocalCarrierSum ιA ιB)) (a : Outcome) :
   113	    (roleBlockProjMeas MA MB).outcome a = roleBlock (MA.outcome a) (MB.outcome a) :=

   116	/--
   117	Heterogeneous role-register projective measurement for a two-space strategy.
   118	
   119	The `Role.A` sector acts on Alice's original summand and the `Role.B` sector
   120	acts on Bob's original summand, as in the role-register symmetrization in
   121	`references/ldt-paper/inductive_step.tex:40-59`.  The complementary direct-sum
   122	sectors are filled by the canonical distinguished-outcome projective
   123	measurement.  Those sectors are auxiliary: in the eventual heterogeneous
   124	symmetrized state, the occupied sectors are `(Role.A, Sum.inl _)` on the left
   125	and `(Role.B, Sum.inr _)` on the right, together with their swapped copy. -/
   126	noncomputable def roleRegisterProjMeas {Outcome ιA ιB : Type*}
   127	    [Inhabited Outcome] [Fintype Outcome]
   128	    [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
   129	    (MA : ProjMeas Outcome ιA) (MB : ProjMeas Outcome ιB) :
   130	    ProjMeas Outcome (RoleRegisterLocal ιA ιB) :=
   131	  let fillerA : ProjMeas Outcome ιA := ProjMeas.trivialDistinguishedOutcome default
   132	  let fillerB : ProjMeas Outcome ιB := ProjMeas.trivialDistinguishedOutcome default
   133	  roleBlockProjMeas
   134	    (localDirectSumProjMeas MA fillerB)
   135	    (localDirectSumProjMeas fillerA MB)

   131	/-- Removing the last coordinate and then applying `Parameters.next` recovers the
   132	original non-base parameters. -/
   133	theorem previous_next_eq (params : Parameters) (hm : 1 < params.m) :
   134	    (previous params hm).next = params := by
   135	  cases params with
   136	  | mk m q d hm0 hq hqPrimePower =>
   137	      have hsub : m - 1 + 1 = m := Nat.sub_add_cancel (le_of_lt hm)
   138	      simp [previous, Parameters.next, hsub]

   140	/-- A bundled predecessor for a parameter set known to be a successor dimension. -/
   141	structure SuccessorDecomposition (params : Parameters) where
   142	  /-- The predecessor parameter bundle. -/
   143	  pred : Parameters
   144	  /-- The predecessor's successor is the original parameter bundle. -/
   145	  next_eq : pred.next = params
   146	
   147	/-- Every parameter bundle of dimension strictly larger than one has a bundled
   148	predecessor whose successor is propositionally equal to the original bundle. -/
   149	def successorDecompositionOfOneLtM (params : Parameters) (hm : 1 < params.m) :
   150	    SuccessorDecomposition params where
   151	  pred := previous params hm
   152	  next_eq := previous_next_eq params hm
   153	
   154	/-- A positive dimension that is not the base dimension is strictly larger than
   155	one. -/
   156	theorem one_lt_m_of_ne_one (params : Parameters) (hm_ne_one : params.m ≠ 1) :
   157	    1 < params.m :=
   158	  lt_of_le_of_ne params.hm (Ne.symm hm_ne_one)
   159	
   160	/-- Non-base parameters have a bundled predecessor decomposition. -/
   161	def successorDecompositionOfNeOne (params : Parameters) (hm_ne_one : params.m ≠ 1) :
   162	    SuccessorDecomposition params :=
   163	  successorDecompositionOfOneLtM params (one_lt_m_of_ne_one params hm_ne_one)

     4	/-!
     5	# Strategy transport for the directly indexed low-degree game
     6	
     7	This module reads one coordinate of a projective directly indexed strategy as
     8	a two-space mature low individual degree strategy.  The question and answer
     9	transport of `Transport.Questions` supplies the canonical direct question of
    10	every mature line, with the reversed coordinate order and the leading index
    11	of the decoded diagonal direction, together with answer readouts that are
    12	covariant under line rebasing; this establishes all four covariance
    13	conditions of `ProjStrat`.  The module also records exact Born-weight
    14	formulas for both directions of strategy transport.
    15	
    16	## References
    17	
    18	- `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-458`
    19	- `references/ldt-paper/test_definition.tex:49-151`
    20	- `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex`
    21	-/

    34	/-- Regard a matrix-valued projective measurement as a projective measurement

    40	    MIPStarRE.LDT.ProjMeas alpha iota where

   113	/-- The coordinate axis-line family is independent of the chosen affine
   114	parametrization of a mature line. -/
   115	theorem directCoordinateAxisMeasurement_reparam
   116	    (D : DirectLdParams) (r : Fin D.k)
   117	    {iota : Type*} [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
   118	    (M : DirectLdQuestion D →
   119	      MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (DirectLdAnswer D) iota)
   120	    (hM : ∀ q, MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (M q)) :
   121	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   122	    AxisParallelMeasurementReparamInvariant D.toLDTParameters
   123	      (directCoordinateAxisMeasurement D r M hM) := by
   124	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   125	  classical
   126	  intro line t f
   127	  simp only [directCoordinateAxisMeasurement, ProjMeas.postprocess,
   128	    SubMeas.postprocess_outcome, matrixMeasurementToLDTProjMeas_outcome]
   129	  rw [directAxisQuestionOf_rebase]

   131	      Finset.univ.filter (fun answer =>
   132	        directAxisAnswerReadout D r (line.rebaseAt t) answer =
   133	          AxisLinePolynomial.reparamAt f t) =
   134	        Finset.univ.filter (fun answer =>
   135	          directAxisAnswerReadout D r line answer = f) := by
   136	    ext answer
   137	    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
   138	    rw [directAxisAnswerReadout_rebase]
   139	    exact (AxisLinePolynomial.reparamAtEquiv t).injective.eq_iff

   171	private theorem strategy_carrier_nonempty {G : Game} (S : Strategy G) :
   172	    Nonempty (S.ιA × S.ιB) := by
   173	  by_contra h
   174	  rw [not_nonempty_iff] at h
   175	  letI := h
   176	  have hzero : S.ψ = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
   177	  have hnorm := S.ψ_norm
   178	  rw [hzero, norm_zero] at hnorm
   179	  exact zero_ne_one hnorm

     3	/-!
     4	# Question and answer transport for the directly indexed low-degree game
     5	
     6	This module reads mature low individual degree questions as canonical direct
     7	questions and rebases direct answers to the mature line parametrization.
     8	
     9	Points and lines are decoded with the coordinate order reversed
    10	(`directPointEquiv`), so that the suffix-zero direction restriction of the
    11	mature diagonal test becomes the prefix-zero restriction of the direct game.
    12	A mature diagonal line reveals no coordinate index, whereas a direct diagonal
    13	question carries one.  The transported question uses the *leading index* of
    14	the decoded direction, the least coordinate at which the direction is
    15	nonzero.  Under the direct sampler, this is the index attached to the sampled
    16	direction exactly when the direction is nonzero at the sampled index
    17	(`directDiagonalIndexOf_prefixProjection`), an event of conditional
    18	probability `1 - 1/q`; on the mature side, the leading index of a decoded
    19	`j`-restricted direction is `Fin.rev j` exactly when its pivot coordinate is
    20	nonzero (`directDiagonalIndexOf_extendRestrictedDirection`).  Diagonal answers
    21	on zero-direction lines are read as the constant polynomial carrying their
    22	value at the base point, following `rem:ld-win-zero-direction`.
    23	
    24	## References
    25	
    26	- `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:230-272`
    27	- `references/ldt-paper/test_definition.tex:49-65`

    29	- `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex`
    30	-/

   105	/-- The coordinates at which a direct direction vector is nonzero. -/
   106	def directionSupport (D : DirectLdParams) (v : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) :

   111	theorem mem_directionSupport (D : DirectLdParams)

   116	/-- The leading index of a direction: the least coordinate at which it is
   117	nonzero, or the last coordinate for the zero direction.  Every coordinate
   118	before the leading index vanishes, so a direction is the prefix projection of
   119	itself at its leading index, and the pair (leading index, direction) is a
   120	canonical direct diagonal sample.  It is the direct index of the sample
   121	whenever the sampled direction is nonzero at the sampled index. -/

   123	    (v : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) : Fin D.m :=
   124	  open Classical in

   128	/-- Coordinates before the leading index vanish. -/
   129	theorem directDiagonalIndexOf_prefix_zero (D : DirectLdParams)
   130	    (v : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) :

   132	  classical
   133	  intro j hj
   134	  by_contra hne
   135	  have hmem : j ∈ directionSupport D v := (mem_directionSupport D v j).mpr hne
   136	  have hnonempty : (directionSupport D v).Nonempty := ⟨j, hmem⟩
   137	  have hle : directDiagonalIndexOf D v ≤ j := by
   138	    unfold directDiagonalIndexOf
   139	    rw [dif_pos hnonempty]
   140	    exact Finset.min'_le _ _ hmem
   141	  exact absurd (Fin.lt_def.mpr hj) (not_lt.mpr hle)

item.text: The branch comparison itself follows the right probabilistic decomposition: after reversing coordinates, a mature restricted direction equals a direct prefix projection; when the sampled pivot vanishes, the same direction reappears at the next index with probability `1/q`, yielding the stated factor at most two. I’m now stress-testing the equivalences used to turn those pointwise statements into uniform averages, and checking the seed-fiber theorem against the existing game’s unresolved probability proof.

   344	/-- One step of the recursion at a fixed point.  On the generic event the
   345	leading index is the sampled index and the mature defect is bounded by the
   346	direct rejection there; on the vanishing event the restriction agrees with the
   347	restriction at the next index. -/
   348	private theorem diagonal_recursion_step
   349	    (dd : (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) → ℝ)
   350	    (rj : Fin D.m → (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) → ℝ)
   351	    (hrj : ∀ i v, 0 ≤ rj i v)
   352	    (hdd : ∀ v, dd v ≤ rj (directDiagonalIndexOf D v) v)
   353	    (i i' : Fin D.m) (hi : i'.val = i.val + 1) :
   354	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))
   355	        (fun v => dd (directPrefixProjection i v)) ≤
   356	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))
   357	          (fun v => rj i (directPrefixProjection i v)) +
   358	        (Fintype.card (DirectScalarQ D) : ℝ)⁻¹ *
   359	          avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))
   360	            (fun v => dd (directPrefixProjection i' v)) := by
   361	  classical
   362	  have hsplit : ∀ v : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D,
   363	      dd (directPrefixProjection i v) =
   364	        (if v i = 0 then 0 else dd (directPrefixProjection i v)) +
   365	          (if v i = 0 then dd (directPrefixProjection i' v) else 0) := by
   366	    intro v
   367	    by_cases hv : v i = 0
   368	    · rw [if_pos hv, if_pos hv, zero_add,
   369	        directPrefixProjection_succ_of_zero D i i' hi v hv]
   370	    · rw [if_neg hv, if_neg hv, add_zero]
   371	  rw [avgOver_congr _ _ _ hsplit, avgOver_add,
   372	    avgOver_uniform_coord_zero D i i' (by omega) dd]
   373	  refine add_le_add ?_ le_rfl
   374	  refine avgOver_mono _ _ _ fun v => ?_
   375	  by_cases hv : v i = 0
   376	  · rw [if_pos hv]
   377	    exact hrj i _
   378	  · rw [if_neg hv]
   379	    calc dd (directPrefixProjection i v) ≤
   380	        rj (directDiagonalIndexOf D (directPrefixProjection i v))
   381	          (directPrefixProjection i v) := hdd _
   382	      _ = rj i (directPrefixProjection i v) := by
   383	        rw [directDiagonalIndexOf_prefixProjection D i v hv]
   384	
   385	/-- At the last index the mature defect is bounded by the direct rejection
   386	without recursion. -/
   387	private theorem diagonal_recursion_last
   388	    (dd : (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) → ℝ)
   389	    (rj : Fin D.m → (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) → ℝ)
   390	    (hdd : ∀ v, dd v ≤ rj (directDiagonalIndexOf D v) v)
   391	    (i : Fin D.m) (hi : i.val + 1 = D.m) :
   392	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))
   393	        (fun v => dd (directPrefixProjection i v)) ≤
   394	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))
   395	        (fun v => rj i (directPrefixProjection i v)) := by
   396	  refine avgOver_mono _ _ _ fun v => ?_
   397	  calc dd (directPrefixProjection i v) ≤
   398	      rj (directDiagonalIndexOf D (directPrefixProjection i v))
   399	        (directPrefixProjection i v) := hdd _
   400	    _ = rj i (directPrefixProjection i v) := by
   401	      rw [directDiagonalIndexOf_prefixProjection_last D i hi v]
   402	
   403	/-- Summed over the restriction index, the mature diagonal quantities at a
   404	fixed point are at most twice the direct rejections. -/
   405	private theorem diagonal_sum_le
   406	    (dd : (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) → ℝ)
   407	    (rj : Fin D.m → (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) → ℝ)
   408	    (hdd0 : ∀ v, 0 ≤ dd v) (hrj : ∀ i v, 0 ≤ rj i v)
   409	    (hdd : ∀ v, dd v ≤ rj (directDiagonalIndexOf D v) v) :
   410	    ∑ i : Fin D.m, avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))
   411	        (fun v => dd (directPrefixProjection i v)) ≤
   412	      2 * ∑ i : Fin D.m, avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))
   413	        (fun v => rj i (directPrefixProjection i v)) := by
   414	  have hcard : 2 ≤ Fintype.card (DirectScalarQ D) := Fintype.one_lt_card
   415	  refine sum_le_two_mul_sum_of_recursion _ _ (Fintype.card (DirectScalarQ D) : ℝ)
   416	    (by exact_mod_cast hcard) ?_ ?_ ?_
   417	  · intro i
   418	    exact avgOver_nonneg _ _ fun v => hdd0 _
   419	  · intro i i' hi
   420	    exact diagonal_recursion_step D dd rj hrj hdd i i' hi
   421	  · intro i hi
   422	    exact diagonal_recursion_last D dd rj hdd i hi
   423	
   424	end DiagonalRecursion

   626	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D)) fun p =>
   627	        ∑ i : Fin D.m, avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))
   628	          (fun v => F p i (directPrefixProjection i v)) := by
   629	  rw [avgOver_sum]
   630	  have hrev := Equiv.sum_comp Fin.revPerm (fun i =>
   631	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D)) fun p =>
   632	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))
   633	        (fun v => F p i (directPrefixProjection i v)))
   634	  simp only [Fin.revPerm_apply] at hrev
   635	  rw [← hrev]
   636	  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
   637	  exact avgOver_uniform_prod (fun p v => F p (Fin.rev j) (directPrefixProjection (Fin.rev j) v))
   638	
   639	/-- The direct index average of a diagonal quantity, with the point average
   640	taken outside. -/
   641	private theorem avgOver_index_eq
   642	    (F : (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) → Fin D.m → (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) → ℝ) :
   643	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m)) (fun i =>
   644	        avgOver (uniformDistribution
   645	          ((Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) × (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D)))
   646	          (fun pv => F pv.1 i (directPrefixProjection i pv.2))) =
   647	      (D.m : ℝ)⁻¹ * avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D)) fun p =>
   648	        ∑ i : Fin D.m, avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))
   649	          (fun v => F p i (directPrefixProjection i v)) := by
   650	  rw [avgOver_uniform_eq_inv_card_mul_sum, Fintype.card_fin, avgOver_sum]
   651	  congr 1
   652	  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
   653	  exact avgOver_uniform_prod (fun p v => F p i (directPrefixProjection i v))
   654	
   655	/-- The diagonal-line failure with the line on the left is at most twice the
   656	diagonal-line/point branch rejection of the direct game. -/
   657	theorem directCoordinate_diagonal_line_point_le :
   658	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   659	    (directCoordinateProjStrat D S hS r).diagonalLineLeftPointRightFailureProbability ≤
   660	      2 * directLdBranchRejectionProbability D S (.dline, .point) := by
   661	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   662	  unfold ProjStrat.diagonalLineLeftPointRightFailureProbability
   663	  rw [diagonal_line_point_branch_eq, avgOver_index_eq,
   664	    Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => diagonal_line_point_term_eq D S hS r j),
   665	    sum_rev_avgOver_eq D (fun p _ v => diagonalLinePointDefect D S hS r p v), one_div]
   666	  have hmain :
   667	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D)) (fun p =>
   668	          ∑ i : Fin D.m, avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))
   669	            (fun v => diagonalLinePointDefect D S hS r p (directPrefixProjection i v))) ≤
   670	        avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D)) (fun p =>
   671	          2 * ∑ i : Fin D.m, avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))
   672	            (fun v => diagonalLinePointRejection D S p i (directPrefixProjection i v))) := by
   673	    refine avgOver_mono _ _ _ fun p => ?_
   674	    exact diagonal_sum_le D (fun v => diagonalLinePointDefect D S hS r p v)
   675	      (fun i v => diagonalLinePointRejection D S p i v)
   676	      (fun v => qBipartiteConsDefect_nonneg _ _ _)
   677	      (fun i v => directRejectedMass_nonneg D S _ _)
   678	      (fun v => diagonalLinePointDefect_le D S hS r p v)
   679	  rw [avgOver_const_mul] at hmain
   680	  have hm : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (D.m : ℝ)⁻¹ := by positivity
   681	  calc (D.m : ℝ)⁻¹ * _ ≤ (D.m : ℝ)⁻¹ * (2 * _) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmain hm
   682	    _ = _ := by ring
   683	
   684	/-- The diagonal-line failure with the point on the left is at most twice the
   685	point/diagonal-line branch rejection of the direct game. -/
   686	theorem directCoordinate_diagonal_point_line_le :
   687	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   688	    (directCoordinateProjStrat D S hS r).diagonalPointLeftLineRightFailureProbability ≤
   689	      2 * directLdBranchRejectionProbability D S (.point, .dline) := by
   690	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   691	  unfold ProjStrat.diagonalPointLeftLineRightFailureProbability
   692	  rw [diagonal_point_line_branch_eq, avgOver_index_eq,
   693	    Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => diagonal_point_line_term_eq D S hS r j),
   694	    sum_rev_avgOver_eq D (fun p _ v => diagonalPointLineDefect D S hS r p v), one_div]
   695	  have hmain :
   696	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D)) (fun p =>
   697	          ∑ i : Fin D.m, avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))
   698	            (fun v => diagonalPointLineDefect D S hS r p (directPrefixProjection i v))) ≤
   699	        avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D)) (fun p =>
   700	          2 * ∑ i : Fin D.m, avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))
   701	            (fun v => diagonalPointLineRejection D S p i (directPrefixProjection i v))) := by
   702	    refine avgOver_mono _ _ _ fun p => ?_
   703	    exact diagonal_sum_le D (fun v => diagonalPointLineDefect D S hS r p v)
   704	      (fun i v => diagonalPointLineRejection D S p i v)
   705	      (fun v => qBipartiteConsDefect_nonneg _ _ _)
   706	      (fun i v => directRejectedMass_nonneg D S _ _)
   707	      (fun v => diagonalPointLineDefect_le D S hS r p v)
   708	  rw [avgOver_const_mul] at hmain
   709	  have hm : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (D.m : ℝ)⁻¹ := by positivity
   710	  calc (D.m : ℝ)⁻¹ * _ ≤ (D.m : ℝ)⁻¹ * (2 * _) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmain hm
   711	    _ = _ := by ring

    29	/-- Regard direct-game parameters as parameters of the mature LDT interface.
    30	The field size, dimension, and degree are unchanged. -/
    31	@[reducible] def DirectLdParams.toLDTParameters (D : DirectLdParams) : Parameters where
    32	  m := D.m
    33	  q := D.q
    34	  d := D.d
    35	  hm := lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one D.hm
    36	  hq := by
    37	    obtain ⟨n, hn, hq⟩ := D.hq
    38	    rw [hq]
    39	    exact Nat.pow_pos (by decide)
    40	  hqPrimePower := by
    41	    obtain ⟨n, hn, hq⟩ := D.hq
    42	    exact ⟨2, n, Nat.prime_two, hn.pos, hq⟩

    44	/-- The fixed QPBT field model, viewed as the model used by the mature LDT
    45	interface. -/
    46	@[reducible] noncomputable def DirectLdParams.toLDTFieldModel (D : DirectLdParams) :
    47	    FieldModel D.toLDTParameters.q :=
    48	  D.model.toFieldModel

    50	/-- Coordinate coding from the direct scalar field to the mature LDT carrier. -/
    51	noncomputable def directScalarEquiv (D : DirectLdParams) :
    52	    DirectScalarQ D ≃ Fq D.toLDTParameters :=
    53	  binaryRepresentation D.model
    54	
    55	/-- Coordinate coding identifies direct points with mature LDT points, with
    56	the coordinate order reversed: direct coordinate `j` is mature coordinate
    57	`Fin.rev j`.  The direct game zeroes a *prefix* of a sampled diagonal
    58	direction (`directPrefixProjection`, paper equation `eq:cl-dlnf`), whereas
    59	the mature test zeroes a *suffix* (`extendRestrictedDirection`,
    60	`references/ldt-paper/test_definition.tex:49-65`).  Reversing the coordinate
    61	order aligns the two restriction conventions, as required by the game
    62	correspondence in `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex`. -/
    63	noncomputable def directPointEquiv (D : DirectLdParams) :
    64	    (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) ≃ Point D.toLDTParameters where
    65	  toFun u i := directScalarEquiv D (u (Fin.rev i))
    66	  invFun u j := (directScalarEquiv D).symm (u (Fin.rev j))
    67	  left_inv u := by
    68	    funext j
    69	    simp
    70	  right_inv u := by
    71	    funext i
    72	    simp
    73	
    74	@[simp] theorem directPointEquiv_apply (D : DirectLdParams)
    75	    (u : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) (i : Fin D.m) :
    76	    directPointEquiv D u i = directScalarEquiv D (u (Fin.rev i)) :=
    77	  rfl

    79	@[simp] theorem directPointEquiv_symm_apply (D : DirectLdParams)
    80	    (u : Point D.toLDTParameters) (j : Fin D.m) :
    81	    (directPointEquiv D).symm u j =
    82	      (directScalarEquiv D).symm (u (Fin.rev j)) :=
    83	  rfl
