    85	/-! ## Bounded coefficient vectors -/
    86	
    87	/-- Turn a coefficient vector into its polynomial of degree at most `n`. -/
    88	private noncomputable def coefficientPolynomial
    89	    {K : Type*} [Field K] (n : ℕ) (c : Fin (n + 1) → K) : Polynomial K :=
    90	  ((Polynomial.degreeLTEquiv K (n + 1)).symm c).1
    91	
    92	private theorem coefficientPolynomial_degree_le
    93	    {K : Type*} [Field K] (n : ℕ) (c : Fin (n + 1) → K) :
    94	    (coefficientPolynomial n c).natDegree ≤ n := by
    95	  let p := (Polynomial.degreeLTEquiv K (n + 1)).symm c
    96	  have hp : p.1 ∈ Polynomial.degreeLE K n := by
    97	    rw [← Polynomial.degreeLT_succ_eq_degreeLE]
    98	    exact p.2
    99	  have hdegree : p.1.degree ≤ n := Polynomial.mem_degreeLE.mp hp
   100	  by_cases hzero : p.1 = 0
   101	  · simp [coefficientPolynomial, p, hzero]
   102	  · exact Polynomial.natDegree_le_iff_degree_le.mpr hdegree
   103	
   104	@[simp] private theorem coefficientPolynomial_coeff
   105	    {K : Type*} [Field K] (n : ℕ) (c : Fin (n + 1) → K)
   106	    (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
   107	    (coefficientPolynomial n c).coeff i = c i := by
   108	  exact congrFun ((Polynomial.degreeLTEquiv K (n + 1)).apply_symm_apply c) i
   109	
   110	private theorem coefficientPolynomial_eval
   111	    {K : Type*} [Field K] (n : ℕ) (c : Fin (n + 1) → K) (t : K) :
   112	    (coefficientPolynomial n c).eval t = evalCoefficient c t := by
   113	  simpa [coefficientPolynomial, evalCoefficient] using
   114	    (Polynomial.eval_eq_sum_degreeLTEquiv
   115	      (((Polynomial.degreeLTEquiv K (n + 1)).symm c).2) t)
   116	
   117	/-- Direct axis-line coefficients are equivalent to mature bounded axis-line
   118	polynomials over the fixed field model. -/
   119	noncomputable def directAxisAnswerEquiv (D : DirectLdParams) :
   120	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   121	    DirectDegPoly D D.d ≃ AxisLinePolynomial D.toLDTParameters := by
   122	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   123	  refine
   124	    { toFun := fun c =>
   125	        { poly := coefficientPolynomial D.d c
   126	          degreeBounded := coefficientPolynomial_degree_le D.d c }
   127	      invFun := fun f i => f.poly.coeff i
   128	      left_inv := ?_
   129	      right_inv := ?_ }
   130	  · intro c
   131	    funext i
   132	    exact coefficientPolynomial_coeff D.d c i
   133	  · intro f
   134	    apply AxisLinePolynomial.ext
   135	    apply linePolynomial_coeff_fin_injective D.toLDTParameters
   136	      (coefficientPolynomial_degree_le D.d fun i => f.poly.coeff i)
   137	      f.degreeBounded
   138	    intro i
   139	    exact coefficientPolynomial_coeff D.d (fun j => f.poly.coeff j) i
   140	
   141	/-- Direct diagonal-line coefficients are equivalent to mature bounded
   142	diagonal-line polynomials over the fixed field model. -/
   143	noncomputable def directDiagonalAnswerEquiv (D : DirectLdParams) :
   144	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   145	    DirectDegPoly D (D.m * D.d) ≃ DiagonalLinePolynomial D.toLDTParameters := by
   146	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   147	  refine
   148	    { toFun := fun c =>
   149	        { poly := coefficientPolynomial (D.m * D.d) c
   150	          degreeBounded := coefficientPolynomial_degree_le (D.m * D.d) c }
   151	      invFun := fun f i => f.poly.coeff i
   152	      left_inv := ?_
   153	      right_inv := ?_ }
   154	  · intro c
   155	    funext i
   156	    exact coefficientPolynomial_coeff (D.m * D.d) c i
   157	  · intro f
   158	    apply DiagonalLinePolynomial.ext
   159	    apply linePolynomial_coeff_fin_injective D.toLDTParameters
   160	      (coefficientPolynomial_degree_le (D.m * D.d) fun i => f.poly.coeff i)
   161	      f.degreeBounded
   162	    intro i
   163	    exact coefficientPolynomial_coeff (D.m * D.d) (fun j => f.poly.coeff j) i
   164	
   165	/-- Coefficient evaluation agrees with evaluation of the corresponding mature
   166	axis-line polynomial. -/
   167	theorem directAxisAnswerEquiv_apply (D : DirectLdParams)
   168	    (c : DirectDegPoly D D.d) (t : DirectScalarQ D) :
   169	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   170	    directAxisAnswerEquiv D c (directScalarEquiv D t) =
   171	      directScalarEquiv D (evalCoefficient c t) := by
   172	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   173	  simp only [directAxisAnswerEquiv, AxisLinePolynomial.toFun,
   174	    evalLinePolynomialModel]
   175	  rw [show decodeScalar (directScalarEquiv D t) = t by
   176	    exact (FieldModel.equiv (q := D.q)).symm_apply_apply t]
   177	  change encodeScalar ((coefficientPolynomial D.d c).eval t) =
   178	    directScalarEquiv D (evalCoefficient c t)
   179	  exact congrArg (FieldModel.equiv (q := D.q))
   180	    (coefficientPolynomial_eval D.d c t)
   181	
   182	/-- Coefficient evaluation agrees with evaluation of the corresponding mature
   183	diagonal-line polynomial. -/
   184	theorem directDiagonalAnswerEquiv_apply (D : DirectLdParams)
   185	    (c : DirectDegPoly D (D.m * D.d)) (t : DirectScalarQ D) :
   186	    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   187	    directDiagonalAnswerEquiv D c (directScalarEquiv D t) =
   188	      directScalarEquiv D (evalCoefficient c t) := by
   189	  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
   190	  simp only [directDiagonalAnswerEquiv, DiagonalLinePolynomial.toFun,
   191	    evalLinePolynomialModel]
   192	  rw [show decodeScalar (directScalarEquiv D t) = t by
   193	    exact (FieldModel.equiv (q := D.q)).symm_apply_apply t]
   194	  change encodeScalar ((coefficientPolynomial (D.m * D.d) c).eval t) =
   195	    directScalarEquiv D (evalCoefficient c t)
   196	  exact congrArg (FieldModel.equiv (q := D.q))
   197	    (coefficientPolynomial_eval (D.m * D.d) c t)

   201	/-- Forget the divisibility field and expose the directly indexed parameters. -/
   202	def LdParams.toDirectLdParams (L : LdParams) : DirectLdParams where
   203	  q := L.q

   206	  k := L.k

   212	@[simp] theorem LdParams.toDirectLdParams_model (L : LdParams) :

   217	/-- The positive cardinality of every seed-fiber residue type. -/
   218	theorem LdParams.seedFiberCard_pos (L : LdParams) : 0 < L.q / L.m := by
   219	  exact Nat.div_pos (Nat.le_of_dvd (by
   220	    obtain ⟨n, hn, hq⟩ := L.hq
   221	    rw [hq]
   222	    exact Nat.pow_pos (by decide)) L.hdvd) L.hm
   223	
   224	/-- Divisibility identifies the field cardinality with the product of the
   225	index cardinality and the common fiber cardinality. -/
   226	theorem LdParams.seedFiberProduct_eq (L : LdParams) :
   227	    L.q = L.m * (L.q / L.m) :=
   228	  (Nat.mul_div_cancel' L.hdvd).symm
   229	
   230	/-- Casting between equal finite cardinalities preserves the underlying
   231	natural-number representative. -/
   232	@[simp] private theorem equivCastFin_val {m n : ℕ} (h : m = n) (i : Fin m) :
   233	    (Equiv.cast (congrArg Fin h) i).val = i.val := by
   234	  subst n
   235	  rfl

   237	/-- A field seed is uniquely a coordinate index and a residue in its equal
   238	`chiIndex` fiber. -/
   239	noncomputable def seedFiberEquiv (L : LdParams) :
   240	    ScalarQ L ≃ Fin L.m × Fin (L.q / L.m) :=
   241	  (binaryRepresentation L.model).trans <|
   242	    (Equiv.cast <| congrArg Fin L.seedFiberProduct_eq).trans
   243	      finProdFinEquiv.symm
   244	
   245	@[simp] theorem seedFiberEquiv_fst (L : LdParams) (s : ScalarQ L) :
   246	    (seedFiberEquiv L s).1 = chiIndex L s := by
   247	  letI : NeZero L.m := ⟨Nat.ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one L.hm)⟩
   248	  have hquot : (binaryRepresentation L.model s).val / (L.q / L.m) < L.m := by
   249	    apply (Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul L.seedFiberCard_pos).mpr
   250	    rw [Nat.mul_div_cancel' L.hdvd]
   251	    exact (binaryRepresentation L.model s).isLt
   252	  simp only [seedFiberEquiv, Equiv.trans_apply]
   253	  apply Fin.ext
   254	  change
   255	    (Equiv.cast (congrArg Fin L.seedFiberProduct_eq)
   256	      (binaryRepresentation L.model s)).val / (L.q / L.m) =
   257	      (Fin.ofNat L.m ((binaryRepresentation L.model s).val / (L.q / L.m))).val
   258	  rw [equivCastFin_val]
   259	  · exact (Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hquot).symm
   260	  · exact L.seedFiberProduct_eq
   261	
   262	/-- Reconstruct the seed belonging to a coordinate and its fiber residue. -/
   263	noncomputable def seedOfIndexResidue (L : LdParams)
   264	    (i : Fin L.m) (r : Fin (L.q / L.m)) : ScalarQ L :=
   265	  (seedFiberEquiv L).symm (i, r)

   267	@[simp] theorem seedFiberEquiv_seedOfIndexResidue (L : LdParams)

   269	    seedFiberEquiv L (seedOfIndexResidue L i r) = (i, r) :=

   272	@[simp] theorem chiIndex_seedOfIndexResidue (L : LdParams)
   273	    (i : Fin L.m) (r : Fin (L.q / L.m)) :
   274	    chiIndex L (seedOfIndexResidue L i r) = i := by
   275	  rw [← seedFiberEquiv_fst]
   276	  simp

   278	/-- Constructor-preserving equivalence between answers of the seed-indexed
   279	and directly indexed QPBT games. -/
   280	noncomputable def ldDirectAnswerEquiv (L : LdParams) :
   281	    LdAnswer L ≃ DirectLdAnswer L.toDirectLdParams where
   282	  toFun
   283	    | .pointVals a => .pointVals a
   284	    | .alinePolys a => .alinePolys a
   285	    | .dlinePolys a => .dlinePolys a
   286	  invFun
   287	    | .pointVals a => .pointVals a
   288	    | .alinePolys a => .alinePolys a
   289	    | .dlinePolys a => .dlinePolys a
   290	  left_inv a := by cases a <;> rfl

   293	/-! ## Parsing seed-indexed questions -/
   294	
   295	/-- Parse a seed-indexed question into the directly indexed question carrying
   296	the coordinate selected by `chiIndex`. -/
   297	noncomputable def parseLdQuestion (L : LdParams) :
   298	    LdQuestion L → DirectLdQuestion L.toDirectLdParams
   299	  | (.point, z) =>
   300	      (.point, ⟨z.point, L.toDirectLdParams.firstIndex, 0⟩)
   301	  | (.aline, z) =>
   302	      (.aline, ⟨z.point, chiIndex L z.seed, 0⟩)
   303	  | (.dline, z) =>
   304	      (.dline, ⟨z.point, chiIndex L z.seed, z.direction⟩)

   306	/-- Embed a direct sample into the seed-indexed ambient space using the
   307	specified residue in the selected seed fiber. -/
   308	noncomputable def ldSpaceOfDirectResidue (L : LdParams)
   309	    (sample : DirectLdSpace L.toDirectLdParams)
   310	    (residue : Fin (L.q / L.m)) : LdSpace L
   311	  | .inl (.inl i) => sample.point i
   312	  | .inl (.inr _) => seedOfIndexResidue L sample.index residue
   313	  | .inr i => sample.direction i

   315	@[simp] theorem ldSpaceOfDirectResidue_point (L : LdParams)
   316	    (sample : DirectLdSpace L.toDirectLdParams)
   317	    (residue : Fin (L.q / L.m)) :
   318	    (ldSpaceOfDirectResidue L sample residue).point = sample.point :=

   323	    (residue : Fin (L.q / L.m)) :

     3	/-!
     4	# Diagonal branches of the coordinate strategies of the direct low-degree game
     5	
     6	The mature `j`-restricted diagonal sampler decodes to a direct direction with
     7	vanishing prefix below the reversed index `i = Fin.rev j`, and the transported
     8	question of `Transport.Questions` carries the leading index of that direction.
     9	On the generic event that the direction is nonzero at `i`, the leading index
    10	is `i` and the question is the canonical direct question of the direct sample
    11	`(p, i, v)`, where the mature defect is bounded by the direct rejection.
    12	Otherwise the restricted direction is also the restriction at the next index,
    13	so the mature quantity recurses to that index with the factor `q⁻¹`, the
    14	probability that the sampled coordinate vanishes; at the last index the zero
    15	direction has the last coordinate as its leading index by convention and no
    16	recursion occurs.  Summing the recursion shows that each mature diagonal
    17	branch is at most `q / (q - 1) ≤ 2` times the corresponding branch rejection
    18	of the direct game.  The factor is genuine: a strategy that answers the
    19	canonical question of a direction badly and the non-canonical questions of the
    20	same geometric line well has mature diagonal failure exceeding the direct
    21	branch rejection.
    22	
    23	## References
    24	
    25	- `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:214-458`
    26	- `references/ldt-paper/test_definition.tex:49-65,130-151`
    27	- `blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:38-121`
    28	- `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex`
    29	-/

    40	/-! ## Direction coordinates and the one-coordinate recursion
    41	
    42	The mature `j`-restricted diagonal sampler decodes to a direct direction with
    43	vanishing prefix below the reversed index `i = Fin.rev j`, and the transported
    44	question carries the leading index of that direction.  On the generic event
    45	that the direction is nonzero at `i`, the leading index is `i` and the
    46	question is the canonical direct question of the direct sample `(p, i, v)`.
    47	Otherwise the restricted direction is also the restriction at the next index,
    48	so the mature quantity recurses with the factor `q⁻¹`, the probability that
    49	the sampled coordinate vanishes.  At the last index the zero direction has the
    50	last coordinate as its leading index by convention, and no recursion occurs. -/

    56	/-- Restricting at an index where the direction vanishes is restricting at the

    59	    (i i' : Fin D.m) (hi : i'.val = i.val + 1)
    60	    (v : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) (hv : v i = 0) :
    61	    directPrefixProjection i v = directPrefixProjection i' v := by
    62	  funext j
    63	  unfold directPrefixProjection
    64	  by_cases hj : j.val < i.val
    65	  · rw [if_pos hj, if_pos (by omega)]
    66	  · by_cases hj' : j.val < i'.val
    67	    · rw [if_neg hj, if_pos hj']

    69	      rw [hji, hv]
    70	    · rw [if_neg hj, if_neg hj']

    72	/-- Restriction beyond a coordinate ignores translation along that

    75	    (i i' : Fin D.m) (hi : i.val < i'.val)

    77	    directPrefixProjection i' (v + c • Pi.single i (1 : DirectScalarQ D)) =

    83	  · rw [if_neg hj, if_neg hj]

   121	/-- Restricting to the vanishing of a coordinate below the restriction index
   122	scales the uniform average by the inverse field size: translation along that

   124	private theorem avgOver_uniform_coord_zero (i i' : Fin D.m) (hi : i.val < i'.val)
   125	    (G : (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) → ℝ) :
   126	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))
   127	        (fun v => if v i = 0 then G (directPrefixProjection i' v) else 0) =

   131	  classical

   133	      (∑ v : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D,
   134	        if v i = c then G (directPrefixProjection i' v) else 0) =
   135	      ∑ v : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D,
   136	        if v i = 0 then G (directPrefixProjection i' v) else 0 := by
   137	    intro c
   138	    refine Fintype.sum_equiv
   139	      (Equiv.addRight ((-c) • Pi.single i (1 : DirectScalarQ D))) _ _ ?_
   140	    intro v

   152	        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun v _ => ?_
   153	        rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq]

   155	      _ = ∑ c : DirectScalarQ D, ∑ v : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D,
   156	            if v i = c then G (directPrefixProjection i' v) else 0 :=

   162	        rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul]

   169	/-- Split a direct direction into the mature free coordinates of the
   170	`j`-restricted diagonal test, read in reversed coordinate order, and the
   171	coordinates below the reversed index. -/
   172	private def restrictedDirectionEquiv (j : Fin D.m) :
   173	    (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) ≃
   174	      (Fin (j.val + 1) → Fq D.toLDTParameters) ×
   175	        (Fin (Fin.rev j).val → DirectScalarQ D) where
   176	  toFun v :=
   177	    (fun c => directScalarEquiv D (v ⟨D.m - 1 - c.val, by have := D.hm; omega⟩),
   178	      fun c => v ⟨c.val, by
   179	        have h1 := c.isLt
   180	        have h2 := Fin.val_rev j
   181	        omega⟩)
   182	  invFun x := fun c =>
   183	    if h : c.val < (Fin.rev j).val then x.2 ⟨c.val, h⟩
   184	    else (directScalarEquiv D).symm
   185	      (x.1 ⟨D.m - 1 - c.val, by
   186	        have h1 := c.isLt
   187	        have h2 := j.isLt
   188	        have h3 := Fin.val_rev j
   189	        omega⟩)
   190	  left_inv v := by
   191	    funext c
   192	    by_cases h : c.val < (Fin.rev j).val
   193	    · simp only [dif_pos h, Fin.eta]
   194	    · simp only [dif_neg h, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
   195	      refine congrArg v (Fin.ext ?_)
   196	      change D.m - 1 - (D.m - 1 - c.val) = c.val
   197	      have h1 := c.isLt
   198	      have h2 := D.hm
   199	      omega
   200	  right_inv x := by
   201	    refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
   202	    · funext c
   203	      have h1 := c.isLt
   204	      have h2 := j.isLt
   205	      have h3 := Fin.val_rev j
   206	      have hc : ¬ (D.m - 1 - c.val < (Fin.rev j).val) := by omega
   207	      simp only [dif_neg hc, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
   208	      refine congrArg x.1 (Fin.ext ?_)
   209	      change D.m - 1 - (D.m - 1 - c.val) = c.val
   210	      omega
   211	    · funext c
   212	      simp only [dif_pos c.isLt, Fin.eta]

   271	/-- Geometric-series bookkeeping for the one-coordinate recursion.  If every
   272	term is at most its rejection term plus `q⁻¹` times the term at the next
   273	index, and the term at the last index is at most its rejection term, then the
   274	sum is at most twice the sum of the rejection terms once `q ≥ 2`. -/
   275	private theorem sum_le_two_mul_sum_of_recursion {m : ℕ} (t r : Fin m → ℝ) (q : ℝ)
   276	    (hq : 2 ≤ q) (ht : ∀ i, 0 ≤ t i)
   277	    (hstep : ∀ i i' : Fin m, i'.val = i.val + 1 → t i ≤ r i + q⁻¹ * t i')
   278	    (hlast : ∀ i : Fin m, i.val + 1 = m → t i ≤ r i) :
   279	    ∑ i, t i ≤ 2 * ∑ i, r i := by
   280	  classical
   281	  have hq0 : (0 : ℝ) < q := by linarith
   282	  have hqinv : q⁻¹ ≤ (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ := inv_anti₀ (by norm_num) hq
   283	  have hqinv0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ q⁻¹ := inv_nonneg.mpr hq0.le
   284	  let succSum : Fin m → ℝ := fun i =>
   285	    ∑ i' : Fin m, if i'.val = i.val + 1 then t i' else 0
   286	  have hbound : ∀ i, t i ≤ r i + q⁻¹ * succSum i := by
   287	    intro i
   288	    by_cases h : i.val + 1 < m
   289	    · have hsucc : succSum i = t ⟨i.val + 1, h⟩ := by
   290	        simp only [succSum]
   291	        rw [Finset.sum_eq_single ⟨i.val + 1, h⟩]
   292	        · simp
   293	        · intro b _ hb
   294	          rw [if_neg]
   295	          intro hb'
   296	          exact hb (Fin.ext hb')
   297	        · intro habs
   298	          exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) habs
   299	      rw [hsucc]
   300	      exact hstep i ⟨i.val + 1, h⟩ rfl

     4	/-!
     5	# Value of the seed-fiber dilation
     6	
     7	The correlated seed-fiber dilation `ldStrategyToDirect` reads a strategy for
     8	the seed-indexed low-degree game as a strategy for the directly indexed game.
     9	This module shows that the dilation preserves the value exactly.
    10	
    11	The direct game asks the canonical questions of a common direct sample.  In
    12	each residue block the dilated strategy asks the original strategy the seeded
    13	canonical questions of that sample; since canonicalizing a canonical sample
    14	changes nothing, these are the seed-indexed questions of the common sample
    15	carrying that residue.  The Born weight of the dilation is the uniform average
    16	of the original Born weights over the residue, the predicates agree after
    17	parsing, and the seed-indexed sample is a direct sample together with a
    18	uniform residue, so the two averages coincide branch by branch, including the
    19	point/point, line/line, and wrong-form clauses and the zero-direction
    20	convention.
    21	
    22	## References
    23	
    24	- `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:214-458`
    25	- `blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:38-121`
    26	- `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex`
    27	-/

    38	/-- Prefix restriction is idempotent. -/
    39	private theorem directPrefixProjection_idem (D : DirectLdParams) (i : Fin D.m)
    40	    (v : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) :
    41	    directPrefixProjection i (directPrefixProjection i v) = directPrefixProjection i v := by
    42	  funext j

    46	/-- Canonicalizing the seeded embedding of a canonical direct sample gives the
    47	canonical seeded sample of the original direct sample: the seed-indexed
    48	question asked in a residue block of the dilation is the seed-indexed
    49	question of the common sample carrying that residue. -/
    50	theorem ldCL_ldSpaceOfDirectResidue_directLdMap (L : LdParams) (t : LdType)
    51	    (sample : DirectLdSpace L.toDirectLdParams) (residue : Fin (L.q / L.m)) :
    52	    ldCL L t (ldSpaceOfDirectResidue L
    53	        (directLdMap L.toDirectLdParams t sample) residue) =
    54	      ldCL L t (ldSpaceOfDirectResidue L sample residue) := by
    55	  cases t with
    56	  | point =>
    57	      funext idx
    58	      rcases idx with (j | ⟨⟩) | j <;> rfl
    59	  | aline =>
    60	      funext idx
    61	      rcases idx with (j | ⟨⟩) | j
    62	      · simp only [ldCL, ldALineCL, ldSpaceOfDirectResidue_point,
    63	          ldSpaceOfDirectResidue_seed, directLdMap, chiIndex_seedOfIndexResidue]
    64	        exact congrFun (lineRepMap_apply_self _ _) j
    65	      · rfl
    66	      · rfl
    67	  | dline =>
    68	      funext idx
    69	      rcases idx with (j | ⟨⟩) | j
    70	      · simp only [ldCL, ldDLineCL, ldSpaceOfDirectResidue_point,
    71	          ldSpaceOfDirectResidue_seed, ldSpaceOfDirectResidue_direction, directLdMap,
    72	          chiIndex_seedOfIndexResidue]
    73	        change lineRepMap
    74	            (directPrefixProjection sample.index
    75	              (directPrefixProjection sample.index sample.direction))
    76	            (lineRepMap (directPrefixProjection sample.index sample.direction)
    77	              sample.point) j =
    78	          lineRepMap (directPrefixProjection sample.index sample.direction) sample.point j
    79	        rw [directPrefixProjection_idem]
    80	        exact congrFun (lineRepMap_apply_self _ _) j
    81	      · rfl
    82	      · simp only [ldCL, ldDLineCL, ldSpaceOfDirectResidue_seed,
    83	          ldSpaceOfDirectResidue_direction, directLdMap, chiIndex_seedOfIndexResidue]
    84	        change directPrefixProjection sample.index
    85	            (directPrefixProjection sample.index sample.direction) j =
    86	          directPrefixProjection sample.index sample.direction j
    87	        rw [directPrefixProjection_idem]

    89	/-- Accepted Born mass at a fixed pair of seed-indexed questions. -/
    90	private def ldAcceptedMass (L : LdParams) (S : Strategy (ldGame L))
    91	    (x y : LdQuestion L) : ℝ :=
    92	  ∑ a : LdAnswer L, ∑ b : LdAnswer L,
    93	    if ldWinPredicate L x y a b then outcomeWeight S x y a b else 0
    94	
    95	/-- Accepted Born mass at a fixed pair of direct questions. -/
    96	private def directAcceptedMass (D : DirectLdParams) (S : Strategy (directLdGame D))
    97	    (x y : DirectLdQuestion D) : ℝ :=
    98	  ∑ a : DirectLdAnswer D, ∑ b : DirectLdAnswer D,
    99	    if directLdWinPredicate D x y a b then outcomeWeight S x y a b else 0
   100	
   101	/-- At the canonical direct questions of a common direct sample, the accepted
   102	mass of the dilation is the uniform residue average of the accepted mass of
   103	the original strategy at the seeded canonical questions. -/
   104	private theorem directAcceptedMass_ldStrategyToDirect (L : LdParams)
   105	    (S : Strategy (ldGame L)) (tA tB : LdType)
   106	    (sample : DirectLdSpace L.toDirectLdParams) :
   107	    directAcceptedMass L.toDirectLdParams (ldStrategyToDirect L S)
   108	        (tA, directLdMap L.toDirectLdParams tA sample)
   109	        (tB, directLdMap L.toDirectLdParams tB sample) =
   110	      (Fintype.card (Fin (L.q / L.m)) : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ residue : Fin (L.q / L.m),
   111	        ldAcceptedMass L S
   112	          (tA, ldCL L tA (ldSpaceOfDirectResidue L sample residue))
   113	          (tB, ldCL L tB (ldSpaceOfDirectResidue L sample residue)) := by
   114	  classical
   115	  have hwin : ∀ (residue : Fin (L.q / L.m)) (a b : DirectLdAnswer L.toDirectLdParams),
   116	      directLdWinPredicate L.toDirectLdParams
   117	          (tA, directLdMap L.toDirectLdParams tA sample)
   118	          (tB, directLdMap L.toDirectLdParams tB sample) a b =
   119	        ldWinPredicate L
   120	          (tA, ldCL L tA (ldSpaceOfDirectResidue L sample residue))
   121	          (tB, ldCL L tB (ldSpaceOfDirectResidue L sample residue))
   122	          ((ldDirectAnswerEquiv L).symm a) ((ldDirectAnswerEquiv L).symm b) := by
   123	    intro residue a b
   124	    rw [← ldWinPredicate_parse, parseLdQuestion_ldCL_ofDirectResidue,
   125	      parseLdQuestion_ldCL_ofDirectResidue, Equiv.apply_symm_apply,
   126	      Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
   127	  have hseeded : ∀ (t : LdType) (residue : Fin (L.q / L.m)),
   128	      seededLdQuestion L (t, directLdMap L.toDirectLdParams t sample) residue =
   129	        (t, ldCL L t (ldSpaceOfDirectResidue L sample residue)) := by
   130	    intro t residue
   131	    exact congrArg (fun z => (t, z))
   132	      (ldCL_ldSpaceOfDirectResidue_directLdMap L t sample residue)
   133	  have hmass : ∀ residue : Fin (L.q / L.m),
   134	      ldAcceptedMass L S
   135	          (tA, ldCL L tA (ldSpaceOfDirectResidue L sample residue))
   136	          (tB, ldCL L tB (ldSpaceOfDirectResidue L sample residue)) =
   137	        ∑ a' : DirectLdAnswer L.toDirectLdParams,
   138	          ∑ b' : DirectLdAnswer L.toDirectLdParams,
   139	            if directLdWinPredicate L.toDirectLdParams
   140	                (tA, directLdMap L.toDirectLdParams tA sample)
   141	                (tB, directLdMap L.toDirectLdParams tB sample) a' b' then
   142	              outcomeWeight S
   143	                (tA, ldCL L tA (ldSpaceOfDirectResidue L sample residue))
   144	                (tB, ldCL L tB (ldSpaceOfDirectResidue L sample residue))
   145	                ((ldDirectAnswerEquiv L).symm a') ((ldDirectAnswerEquiv L).symm b')
   146	            else 0 := by
   147	    intro residue
   148	    unfold ldAcceptedMass
   149	    rw [← Equiv.sum_comp (ldDirectAnswerEquiv L).symm]
   150	    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a' _ => ?_
   151	    rw [← Equiv.sum_comp (ldDirectAnswerEquiv L).symm]
   152	    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b' _ => ?_
   153	    rw [hwin residue a' b']
   154	  unfold directAcceptedMass
   155	  simp only [hmass]
   156	  calc
   157	    ∑ a' : DirectLdAnswer L.toDirectLdParams,
   158	        ∑ b' : DirectLdAnswer L.toDirectLdParams,
   159	          (if directLdWinPredicate L.toDirectLdParams
   160	              (tA, directLdMap L.toDirectLdParams tA sample)
   161	              (tB, directLdMap L.toDirectLdParams tB sample) a' b' then
   162	            outcomeWeight (ldStrategyToDirect L S)
   163	              (tA, directLdMap L.toDirectLdParams tA sample)
   164	              (tB, directLdMap L.toDirectLdParams tB sample) a' b'
   165	          else 0) =
   166	        ∑ a' : DirectLdAnswer L.toDirectLdParams,
   167	          ∑ b' : DirectLdAnswer L.toDirectLdParams,
   168	            ∑ residue : Fin (L.q / L.m),
   169	              (Fintype.card (Fin (L.q / L.m)) : ℝ)⁻¹ *
   170	                (if directLdWinPredicate L.toDirectLdParams
   171	                    (tA, directLdMap L.toDirectLdParams tA sample)
   172	                    (tB, directLdMap L.toDirectLdParams tB sample) a' b' then
   173	                  outcomeWeight S
   174	                    (tA, ldCL L tA (ldSpaceOfDirectResidue L sample residue))
   175	                    (tB, ldCL L tB (ldSpaceOfDirectResidue L sample residue))
   176	                    ((ldDirectAnswerEquiv L).symm a') ((ldDirectAnswerEquiv L).symm b')
   177	                else 0) := by
   178	      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a' _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b' _ => ?_
   179	      by_cases hc : directLdWinPredicate L.toDirectLdParams
   180	          (tA, directLdMap L.toDirectLdParams tA sample)
   181	          (tB, directLdMap L.toDirectLdParams tB sample) a' b' = true
   182	      · simp only [hc, if_true]
   183	        rw [← Finset.mul_sum, ldStrategyToDirect_bornWeight]
   184	        simp only [hseeded]
   185	      · simp [hc]
   186	    _ = ∑ a' : DirectLdAnswer L.toDirectLdParams,
   187	          ∑ residue : Fin (L.q / L.m),
   188	            ∑ b' : DirectLdAnswer L.toDirectLdParams,
   189	              (Fintype.card (Fin (L.q / L.m)) : ℝ)⁻¹ *
   190	                (if directLdWinPredicate L.toDirectLdParams
   191	                    (tA, directLdMap L.toDirectLdParams tA sample)
   192	                    (tB, directLdMap L.toDirectLdParams tB sample) a' b' then
   193	                  outcomeWeight S
   194	                    (tA, ldCL L tA (ldSpaceOfDirectResidue L sample residue))
   195	                    (tB, ldCL L tB (ldSpaceOfDirectResidue L sample residue))
   196	                    ((ldDirectAnswerEquiv L).symm a') ((ldDirectAnswerEquiv L).symm b')
   197	                else 0) :=
   198	      Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a' _ => Finset.sum_comm
   199	    _ = ∑ residue : Fin (L.q / L.m),
   200	          ∑ a' : DirectLdAnswer L.toDirectLdParams,
   201	            ∑ b' : DirectLdAnswer L.toDirectLdParams,
   202	              (Fintype.card (Fin (L.q / L.m)) : ℝ)⁻¹ *
   203	                (if directLdWinPredicate L.toDirectLdParams
   204	                    (tA, directLdMap L.toDirectLdParams tA sample)
   205	                    (tB, directLdMap L.toDirectLdParams tB sample) a' b' then
   206	                  outcomeWeight S
   207	                    (tA, ldCL L tA (ldSpaceOfDirectResidue L sample residue))
   208	                    (tB, ldCL L tB (ldSpaceOfDirectResidue L sample residue))
   209	                    ((ldDirectAnswerEquiv L).symm a') ((ldDirectAnswerEquiv L).symm b')
   210	                else 0) :=
   211	      Finset.sum_comm
   212	    _ = _ := by
   213	      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
   214	      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun residue _ => ?_
   215	      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
   216	      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a' _ => ?_
   217	      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
   218	
   219	/-- The correlated seed-fiber dilation preserves the value exactly: the
   220	direct game's value of `ldStrategyToDirect L S` is the seed-indexed game's
   221	value of `S`.  Both values are averages over the ordered type pair and the
   222	common sample; the direct sample together with a uniform residue is the
   223	seed-indexed sample, and the dilation realizes, in each residue block, the
   224	original strategy at the seed-indexed questions of that sample. -/
   225	theorem ldStrategyToDirect_value_eq (L : LdParams) (S : Strategy (ldGame L)) :
   226	    (ldStrategyToDirect L S).value = S.value := by
   227	  classical
   228	  letI : Nonempty (Fin (L.q / L.m)) :=
   229	    Fin.pos_iff_nonempty.mp L.seedFiberCard_pos
   230	  have hsymm : ∀ b : ((LdType × LdType) × DirectLdSpace L.toDirectLdParams) ×
   231	      Fin (L.q / L.m),
   232	      (ldQuestionSeedFiberEquiv L).symm b =
   233	        (b.1.1, ldSpaceOfDirectResidue L b.1.2 b.2) :=
   234	    fun b => rfl
   235	  change avgOver (directLdQuestionDistribution L.toDirectLdParams)
   236	      (fun xy => directAcceptedMass L.toDirectLdParams (ldStrategyToDirect L S) xy.1 xy.2) =
   237	    avgOver (ldQuestionDistribution L) (fun xy => ldAcceptedMass L S xy.1 xy.2)
   238	  unfold directLdQuestionDistribution ldQuestionDistribution
   239	  rw [Distribution.avgOver_map, Distribution.avgOver_map,
   240	    avgOver_uniform_equiv (ldQuestionSeedFiberEquiv L)]
   241	  simp only [hsymm]
   242	  rw [avgOver_uniform_prod (fun (src : (LdType × LdType) × DirectLdSpace L.toDirectLdParams)
   243	      (residue : Fin (L.q / L.m)) =>
   244	      ldAcceptedMass L S
   245	        (src.1.1, ldCL L src.1.1 (ldSpaceOfDirectResidue L src.2 residue))
   246	        (src.1.2, ldCL L src.1.2 (ldSpaceOfDirectResidue L src.2 residue)))]
   247	  apply avgOver_congr
   248	  intro src
   249	  rw [directAcceptedMass_ldStrategyToDirect, avgOver_uniform_eq_inv_card_mul_sum]
   250	
   251	end

     5	/-!
     6	# Seed-fiber dilation for the directly indexed low-degree game
     7	
     8	This module dilates a seed-indexed low-degree strategy by a maximally
     9	correlated residue register.  Block-diagonal projective measurements retain
    10	arbitrary dependence on the seed within each `chiIndex` fiber.
    11	
    12	## References
    13	
    14	- `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-458`
    15	- `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex`
    16	-/

    27	/-! ## Projective block measurements -/
    28	
    29	/-- Relabel a matrix measurement along an equivalence of outcome alphabets. -/
    30	noncomputable def matrixMeasurementTransport
    31	    {alpha beta iota : Type*}
    32	    [Fintype alpha] [Fintype beta] [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
    33	    (e : alpha ≃ beta) (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement alpha iota) :
    34	    MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement beta iota :=
    35	  MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne
    36	    (fun b => M.effect (e.symm b))
    37	    (fun b => M.pos (e.symm b))
    38	    (by
    39	      calc
    40	        ∑ b, M.effect (e.symm b) = ∑ a, M.effect a :=
    41	          Equiv.sum_comp e.symm M.effect
    42	        _ = 1 := M.sum_eq_one)
    43	
    44	@[simp] theorem matrixMeasurementTransport_effect
    45	    {alpha beta iota : Type*}
    46	    [Fintype alpha] [Fintype beta] [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
    47	    (e : alpha ≃ beta) (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement alpha iota)
    48	    (b : beta) :
    49	    (matrixMeasurementTransport e M).effect b = M.effect (e.symm b) :=
    50	  rfl
    51	
    52	/-- Relabeling a projective matrix measurement preserves projectivity. -/
    53	theorem matrixMeasurementTransport_isProjective
    54	    {alpha beta iota : Type*}
    55	    [Fintype alpha] [Fintype beta] [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
    56	    (e : alpha ≃ beta) (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement alpha iota)
    57	    (hM : MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective M) :
    58	    MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (matrixMeasurementTransport e M) :=
    59	  fun b => hM (e.symm b)
    60	
    61	/-- Assemble a family of matrix measurements as diagonal blocks indexed by a
    62	finite classical register. -/
    63	noncomputable def blockDiagonalMeasurement
    64	    {alpha iota block : Type*}
    65	    [Fintype alpha] [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
    66	    [Fintype block] [DecidableEq block]
    67	    (M : block → MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement alpha iota) :
    68	    MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement alpha (iota × block) :=
    69	  MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne
    70	    (fun a => Matrix.blockDiagonal fun r => (M r).effect a)
    71	    (fun a => Matrix.blockDiagonal_nonneg
    72	      (fun r => (M r).effect a) (fun r => (M r).pos a))
    73	    (by
    74	      ext ⟨i, r⟩ ⟨j, s⟩
    75	      simp only [Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.blockDiagonal_apply]
    76	      by_cases hrs : r = s
    77	      · subst s
    78	        simp only [if_pos]
    79	        calc
    80	          ∑ x, (M r).effect x i j = (1 : Matrix iota iota ℂ) i j :=
    81	            by
    82	              simpa only [Matrix.sum_apply] using
    83	                congrFun (congrFun (M r).sum_eq_one i) j
    84	          _ = (1 : Matrix (iota × block) (iota × block) ℂ)
    85	              (i, r) (j, r) := by
    86	                change (if i = j then 1 else 0) =
    87	                  (if (i, r) = (j, r) then 1 else 0)
    88	                simp
    89	      · simp [hrs])
    90	
    91	@[simp] theorem blockDiagonalMeasurement_effect
    92	    {alpha iota block : Type*}
    93	    [Fintype alpha] [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
    94	    [Fintype block] [DecidableEq block]
    95	    (M : block → MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement alpha iota)
    96	    (a : alpha) :
    97	    (blockDiagonalMeasurement M).effect a =
    98	      Matrix.blockDiagonal (fun r => (M r).effect a) :=
    99	  rfl
   100	
   101	/-- A block-diagonal family of projective measurements is projective. -/
   102	theorem blockDiagonalMeasurement_isProjective
   103	    {alpha iota block : Type*}
   104	    [Fintype alpha] [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
   105	    [Fintype block] [DecidableEq block]
   106	    (M : block → MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement alpha iota)
   107	    (hM : ∀ r, MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (M r)) :
   108	    MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (blockDiagonalMeasurement M) := by
   109	  intro a
   110	  constructor
   111	  · change Matrix.blockDiagonal (fun r => (M r).effect a) *
   112	        Matrix.blockDiagonal (fun r => (M r).effect a) =
   113	      Matrix.blockDiagonal (fun r => (M r).effect a)
   114	    rw [← Matrix.blockDiagonal_mul]
   115	    congr 1
   116	    funext r
   117	    exact (hM r a).isIdempotentElem.eq
   118	  · change (Matrix.blockDiagonal (fun r => (M r).effect a))ᴴ =
   119	      Matrix.blockDiagonal (fun r => (M r).effect a)
   120	    rw [Matrix.blockDiagonal_conjTranspose]
   121	    congr 1
   122	    funext r
   123	    exact (hM r a).isSelfAdjoint.star_eq

   125	/-! ## The correlated residue state -/
   126	
   127	/-- The normalized maximally correlated state on the common seed-fiber
   128	residue. -/
   129	noncomputable def seedResidueAncilla (L : LdParams) :
   130	    EuclideanSpace ℂ
   131	      (Fin (L.q / L.m) × Fin (L.q / L.m)) := by
   132	  letI : Nonempty (Fin (L.q / L.m)) :=
   133	    Fin.pos_iff_nonempty.mp L.seedFiberCard_pos
   134	  exact eprState (Fin (L.q / L.m))
   135	
   136	/-- The seed-residue ancilla has unit norm. -/
   137	theorem seedResidueAncilla_norm (L : LdParams) :
   138	    ‖seedResidueAncilla L‖ = 1 := by
   139	  letI : Nonempty (Fin (L.q / L.m)) :=
   140	    Fin.pos_iff_nonempty.mp L.seedFiberCard_pos
   141	  exact eprState_norm (Fin (L.q / L.m))
   142	
   143	/-- Reindexing Euclidean coordinates along an equivalence preserves norm. -/
   144	theorem reindexState_norm_eq
   145	    {iota kappa : Type*}
   146	    [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
   147	    [Fintype kappa] [DecidableEq kappa]
   148	    (e : iota ≃ kappa) (psi : EuclideanSpace ℂ iota) :
   149	    ‖reindexState e psi‖ = ‖psi‖ := by
   150	  rw [← sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)]
   151	  rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]
   152	  change (∑ j : kappa, ‖psi (e.symm j)‖ ^ 2) = ∑ i : iota, ‖psi i‖ ^ 2
   153	  exact e.symm.sum_comp (fun i => ‖psi i‖ ^ 2)
   154	
   155	/-- The coordinate tensor of two Euclidean vectors has the product norm. -/
   156	theorem vecTensor_norm_eq
   157	    {iota kappa : Type*}
   158	    [Fintype iota] [DecidableEq iota]
   159	    [Fintype kappa] [DecidableEq kappa]
   160	    (u : EuclideanSpace ℂ iota) (v : EuclideanSpace ℂ kappa) :
   161	    ‖vecTensor u v‖ = ‖u‖ * ‖v‖ := by
   162	  rw [← sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))]
   163	  rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, mul_pow, EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq,
   164	    EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]
   165	  change (∑ p : iota × kappa, ‖u p.1 * v p.2‖ ^ 2) =
   166	    (∑ i : iota, ‖u i‖ ^ 2) * ∑ j : kappa, ‖v j‖ ^ 2
   167	  simp only [norm_mul, mul_pow]
   168	  rw [← Finset.univ_product_univ, Finset.sum_product, Finset.sum_mul]
   169	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   170	  intro i hi
   171	  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
   172	
   173	/-- Tensor the original strategy state with the maximally correlated residue
   174	state and shuffle the factors back into the two local carriers. -/
   175	noncomputable def seedFiberLiftedState
   176	    {G : Game} (S : Strategy G) (L : LdParams) :
   177	    EuclideanSpace ℂ
   178	      ((S.ιA × Fin (L.q / L.m)) × (S.ιB × Fin (L.q / L.m))) :=
   179	  reindexState prodShuffle (vecTensor S.ψ (seedResidueAncilla L))
   180	
   181	/-- The correlated seed-fiber lift preserves normalization of the strategy
   182	state. -/
   183	theorem seedFiberLiftedState_norm
   184	    {G : Game} (S : Strategy G) (L : LdParams) :
   185	    ‖seedFiberLiftedState S L‖ = 1 := by
   186	  rw [seedFiberLiftedState, reindexState_norm_eq, vecTensor_norm_eq,
   187	    S.ψ_norm, seedResidueAncilla_norm, one_mul]
   188	
   189	/-! ## From the seed-indexed game to the direct game -/
   190	
   191	/-- The seed-indexed question selected in one residue block of a direct
   192	question.  Applying `ldCL` ensures that irrelevant ambient coordinates are
   193	canonicalized exactly as in the source game. -/
   194	noncomputable def seededLdQuestion (L : LdParams)
   195	    (q : DirectLdQuestion L.toDirectLdParams)
   196	    (residue : Fin (L.q / L.m)) : LdQuestion L :=
   197	  (q.1, ldCL L q.1 (ldSpaceOfDirectResidue L q.2 residue))
   198	
   199	/-- Dilate a strategy for the seed-indexed low-degree game to the directly
   200	indexed game.  The two local carriers receive correlated copies of the seed
   201	residue, and each measurement is block diagonal in that residue. -/
   202	noncomputable def ldStrategyToDirect (L : LdParams)
   203	    (S : Strategy (ldGame L)) : Strategy (directLdGame L.toDirectLdParams) where
   204	  ιA := S.ιA × Fin (L.q / L.m)
   205	  ιB := S.ιB × Fin (L.q / L.m)
   206	  ψ := seedFiberLiftedState S L
   207	  ψ_norm := seedFiberLiftedState_norm S L
   208	  A q := blockDiagonalMeasurement fun residue =>
   209	    matrixMeasurementTransport (ldDirectAnswerEquiv L)
   210	      (S.A (seededLdQuestion L q residue))
   211	  B q := blockDiagonalMeasurement fun residue =>
   212	    matrixMeasurementTransport (ldDirectAnswerEquiv L)
   213	      (S.B (seededLdQuestion L q residue))

+import MIPStarRE.QPBT.Combining.DirectLowDegree.Transport.DiagonalRecursion
+
+/-!
+# Pass conversion for the directly indexed low-degree game
+
+This module converts a value bound for a projective strategy of the directly
+indexed low-degree game into the hypothesis of the mature low individual
+degree theorem for each coordinate strategy `directCoordinateProjStrat`.
+
+The mature failure probability gives weight `1/3` to point agreement and
+`1/6` to each of the four oriented line-versus-point checks.  The branch
+comparisons of `Transport.BranchComparison` and `Transport.DiagonalRecursion`
+bound the point and axis-line branches by the corresponding direct branch
+rejections and each diagonal branch by twice its direct branch rejection.  The
+factor-three rejection calculus of `GameValue` gives the line branches half the
+weight of the point branch, so the factor two is absorbed: a direct strategy of
+value at least `1 - ε` has coordinate strategies of mature failure at most
+`3 * ε`, which is exactly `PassesLowIndividualDegreeTest (3 * ε)`.
+
+## References
+
+- `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:214-458`
+- `references/ldt-paper/test_definition.tex:130-151`
+- `blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:38-121,139-166`
+- `MIPStarRE/LDT/Test/StrategyFailures.lean:18-130`
+- `MIPStarRE/LDT/Test/MainTheorem/MainFormal.lean:300-311`
+- `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex`
+-/
+
+open scoped BigOperators MatrixOrder Matrix ComplexOrder
+
+namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
+
+open MIPStarRE.LDT
+open MIPStarRE.Quantum
+
+noncomputable section
+
+/-! ## The failure comparison and the pass hypothesis -/
+
+private theorem sum_ldType (f : LdType → ℝ) :
+    ∑ t : LdType, f t = f .point + f .aline + f .dline := by
+  change (Finset.univ : Finset LdType).sum f = _
+  rw [show (Finset.univ : Finset LdType) = {.point, .aline, .dline} by decide]
+  simp [add_assoc]
+
+/-- The uniformly weighted rejection is one ninth of the sum over the nine
+ordered type pairs. -/
+private theorem directLdRejectionProbability_eq_sum (D : DirectLdParams)
+    (S : Strategy (directLdGame D)) :
+    directLdRejectionProbability D S =
+      (∑ types : LdType × LdType, directLdBranchRejectionProbability D S types) / 9 := by
+  unfold directLdRejectionProbability
+  rw [avgOver_uniform_eq_inv_card_mul_sum, Fintype.card_prod,
+    show Fintype.card LdType = 3 by decide, div_eq_inv_mul]
+  norm_num
+
+/-- Failure of the coordinate strategy compared with the mature-weighted
+rejection of the direct game.  The point and axis-line branches are dominated
+termwise, while each diagonal branch is dominated up to the factor two of the
+leading-index rereading; the surplus is the extra half weight of the diagonal
+branches.  The bare inequality against `directLdLdtWeightedFailureProbability`
+fails for index-sensitive strategies that answer the canonical question of
+a direction badly and the non-canonical questions of the same geometric line
+well, so the surplus term is not an artifact of the proof. -/
+theorem directCoordinate_failure_le_weightedFailure
+    (D : DirectLdParams) (S : Strategy (directLdGame D))
+    (hS : S.IsProjective) (r : Fin D.k) :
+    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
+    (directCoordinateProjStrat D S hS r).lowIndividualDegreeFailureProbability ≤
+      directLdLdtWeightedFailureProbability D S +
+        (directLdBranchRejectionProbability D S (.dline, .point) +
+          directLdBranchRejectionProbability D S (.point, .dline)) / 6 := by
+  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
+  rw [ProjStrat.lowIndividualDegreeFailureProbability_eq_role_averages]
+  unfold ProjStrat.axisParallelRoleAverage ProjStrat.diagonalRoleAverage
+    directLdLdtWeightedFailureProbability
+  dsimp only
+  have h1 := directCoordinate_axis_line_point_le D S hS r
+  have h2 := directCoordinate_axis_point_line_le D S hS r
+  have h3 := directCoordinate_point_agreement_le D S hS r
+  have h4 := directCoordinate_diagonal_line_point_le D S hS r
+  have h5 := directCoordinate_diagonal_point_line_le D S hS r
+  linarith
+
+/-- Failure of the coordinate strategy is at most three times the uniformly
+weighted rejection of the direct game. -/
+theorem directCoordinate_failure_le_three_mul_rejection
+    (D : DirectLdParams) (S : Strategy (directLdGame D))
+    (hS : S.IsProjective) (r : Fin D.k) :
+    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
+    (directCoordinateProjStrat D S hS r).lowIndividualDegreeFailureProbability ≤
+      3 * directLdRejectionProbability D S := by
+  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
+  have h := directCoordinate_failure_le_weightedFailure D S hS r
+  unfold directLdLdtWeightedFailureProbability at h
+  dsimp only at h
+  rw [directLdRejectionProbability_eq_sum, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
+  simp only [sum_ldType]
+  have hnonneg := directLdBranchRejectionProbability_nonneg D S
+  have hpp := hnonneg (.point, .point)
+  have hpa := hnonneg (.point, .aline)
+  have hpd := hnonneg (.point, .dline)
+  have hap := hnonneg (.aline, .point)
+  have haa := hnonneg (.aline, .aline)
+  have had := hnonneg (.aline, .dline)
+  have hdp := hnonneg (.dline, .point)
+  have hda := hnonneg (.dline, .aline)
+  have hdd := hnonneg (.dline, .dline)
+  linarith
+
+/-- The error passed to the mature theorem is nonnegative: the direct value
+never exceeds one. -/
+theorem directLd_error_nonneg_of_value (D : DirectLdParams)
+    (S : Strategy (directLdGame D)) (ε : ℝ) (hwin : 1 - ε ≤ S.value) :
+    0 ≤ ε := by
+  have h0 : 0 ≤ directLdRejectionProbability D S :=
+    avgOver_nonneg _ _ fun types => directLdBranchRejectionProbability_nonneg D S types
+  rw [directLdRejectionProbability_eq_one_sub_value] at h0
+  linarith
+
+/-- The error `3 * ε` passed to the mature theorem is nonnegative. -/
+theorem directCoordinate_three_mul_error_nonneg (D : DirectLdParams)
+    (S : Strategy (directLdGame D)) (ε : ℝ) (hwin : 1 - ε ≤ S.value) :
+    0 ≤ 3 * ε := by
+  have := directLd_error_nonneg_of_value D S ε hwin
+  linarith
+
+/-- A direct strategy of value at least `1 - ε` has coordinate strategies of
+low individual degree failure at most `3 * ε`. -/
+theorem directCoordinate_failure_le_three_mul_error
+    (D : DirectLdParams) (S : Strategy (directLdGame D))
+    (hS : S.IsProjective) (r : Fin D.k) (ε : ℝ) (hwin : 1 - ε ≤ S.value) :
+    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
+    (directCoordinateProjStrat D S hS r).lowIndividualDegreeFailureProbability ≤
+      3 * ε := by
+  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
+  have hrej : directLdRejectionProbability D S ≤ ε := by
+    rw [directLdRejectionProbability_eq_one_sub_value]
+    linarith
+  calc
+    (directCoordinateProjStrat D S hS r).lowIndividualDegreeFailureProbability ≤
+        3 * directLdRejectionProbability D S :=
+      directCoordinate_failure_le_three_mul_rejection D S hS r
+    _ ≤ 3 * ε := by linarith
+
+/-- The pass hypothesis of the mature low individual degree theorem for every
+coordinate of a direct strategy of value at least `1 - ε`, with error
+`3 * ε` and no further assumption. -/
+theorem directCoordinate_passes
+    (D : DirectLdParams) (S : Strategy (directLdGame D))
+    (hS : S.IsProjective) (r : Fin D.k) (ε : ℝ) (hwin : 1 - ε ≤ S.value) :
+    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
+    (directCoordinateProjStrat D S hS r).PassesLowIndividualDegreeTest (3 * ε) := by
+  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
+  exact ⟨directCoordinate_failure_le_three_mul_error D S hS r ε hwin⟩
+
+end
+
+end MIPStarRE.QPBT

@@ -319,160 +319,167 @@ theorem totalVariationDistance_eq_sum_max_sub {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α]
 /-- A `[0,1]`-valued function has expectations over two probability
 distributions differing by at most their total variation distance.
 
 The statement is oriented for replacement estimates: averaging against `ν` is
 bounded by averaging against `μ`, plus the finite total-variation distance
 between the two distributions. -/
 theorem avgOver_le_avgOver_add_totalVariationDistance {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α]
     (μ ν : Distribution α) (hμ : μ.IsProbability) (hν : ν.IsProbability)
     (f : α → Error)
     (hf_nonneg : ∀ a, 0 ≤ f a)
     (hf_le_one : ∀ a, f a ≤ 1) :
     avgOver ν f ≤ avgOver μ f + totalVariationDistance μ ν := by
   classical
   let u : Finset α := μ.support ∪ ν.support
   have hμ_avg :
       avgOver μ f = ∑ a ∈ u, μ.weight a * f a := by
     unfold avgOver
     have hsubset : μ.support ⊆ u := by
       intro a ha
       exact Finset.mem_union_left ν.support ha
     exact Finset.sum_subset hsubset (fun a _ ha => by rw [μ.outsideSupport a ha, zero_mul])
   have hν_avg :
       avgOver ν f = ∑ a ∈ u, ν.weight a * f a := by
     unfold avgOver
     have hsubset : ν.support ⊆ u := by
       intro a ha
       exact Finset.mem_union_right μ.support ha
     exact Finset.sum_subset hsubset (fun a _ ha => by rw [ν.outsideSupport a ha, zero_mul])
   have hpoint :
       ∀ a, ν.weight a * f a ≤ μ.weight a * f a + max 0 (ν.weight a - μ.weight a) := by
     intro a
     by_cases hle : ν.weight a ≤ μ.weight a
     · have hmul : ν.weight a * f a ≤ μ.weight a * f a := by
         exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hle (hf_nonneg a)
       have hmax : max 0 (ν.weight a - μ.weight a) = 0 := by
         rw [max_eq_left]
         linarith
       rw [hmax]
       linarith
     · have hμν : μ.weight a ≤ ν.weight a := le_of_not_ge hle
       have hdiff_nonneg : 0 ≤ ν.weight a - μ.weight a := by linarith
       have hmul :
           (ν.weight a - μ.weight a) * f a ≤ ν.weight a - μ.weight a := by
         have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hf_le_one a) hdiff_nonneg
         simpa [one_mul] using this
       have hsplit :
           ν.weight a * f a =
             μ.weight a * f a + (ν.weight a - μ.weight a) * f a := by
         ring
       have hmax : max 0 (ν.weight a - μ.weight a) =
           ν.weight a - μ.weight a := max_eq_right hdiff_nonneg
       rw [hsplit, hmax]
       linarith
   have hsum :
       ∑ a ∈ u, ν.weight a * f a ≤
         ∑ a ∈ u, (μ.weight a * f a + max 0 (ν.weight a - μ.weight a)) :=
     Finset.sum_le_sum fun a _ => hpoint a
   have htv :
       totalVariationDistance μ ν =
         ∑ a ∈ u, max 0 (ν.weight a - μ.weight a) := by
     exact totalVariationDistance_eq_sum_max_sub μ ν hμ hν
   rw [hμ_avg, hν_avg]
   calc
     ∑ a ∈ u, ν.weight a * f a
         ≤ ∑ a ∈ u, (μ.weight a * f a + max 0 (ν.weight a - μ.weight a)) :=
           hsum
     _ = ∑ a ∈ u, μ.weight a * f a +
           ∑ a ∈ u, max 0 (ν.weight a - μ.weight a) := by
           rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
     _ = ∑ a ∈ u, μ.weight a * f a + totalVariationDistance μ ν := by
           rw [← htv]

     (v : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D :=

   | axis (base : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) (index : Fin D.m)

   | diagonal (base : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) (index : Fin D.m)
       (direction : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D)

   | .axis _ _ _ => .axis

   | .axis _ index _ => index
   | .diagonal _ index _ _ _ => index

   | .axis base _ _ => base
   | .diagonal base _ _ _ _ => base

     Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D :=

   | .axis _ index _ => coordinateDirection index
   | .diagonal _ _ direction _ _ => direction

     lineRepMap line.direction line.base = line.base := by
   cases line with
   | axis base index baseFixed => exact baseFixed
   | diagonal base index direction baseFixed prefixZero => exact baseFixed

     (line : DirectLineDesc D) (hline : line.kind = .diagonal) :
     ∀ j : Fin D.m, j.val < line.index.val → line.direction j = 0 := by
   cases line with
   | axis base index baseFixed => simp [DirectLineDesc.kind] at hline

+/-!
+# Branch comparison for the coordinate strategies of the direct low-degree game
+
+Every branch of the mature low individual degree failure probability of a
+coordinate strategy `directCoordinateProjStrat` is compared with the ordered
+type-pair branch of the direct game asking the same questions.  An accepted
+direct answer pair reads out to equal mature answers: the line answer, rebased
+to the mature line and evaluated at the mature base point, is the point
+answer, and the zero-direction convention reads the constant value at the base
+point.  Hence the mature inconsistency mass at a question pair is at most the
+rejected direct Born mass there.  The point-agreement and axis-line branches
+then compare exactly after the coordinate reindexing of `directPointEquiv`;
+the diagonal branches are treated in `Transport.DiagonalRecursion`.
+
+## References
+
+- `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:214-458`
+- `references/ldt-paper/test_definition.tex:130-151`
+- `blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:38-121,139-166`
+- `MIPStarRE/LDT/Test/StrategyFailures.lean:18-130`
+- `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex`
+-/
+
+open scoped BigOperators MatrixOrder Matrix ComplexOrder
+
+namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
+
+open MIPStarRE.LDT
+open MIPStarRE.Quantum
+
+noncomputable section
+
+/-- Admissible field sizes are positive, so mature points over a direct
+parameter tuple form a nonempty type. -/
+instance (D : DirectLdParams) : NeZero D.q :=
+  ⟨Nat.ne_of_gt D.toLDTParameters.hq⟩
+
+/-! ## Rejected Born mass at a fixed question pair -/
+
+/-- The Born mass of the rejected answer pairs at a fixed pair of direct
+questions.  Its uniform average over the common direct sample of an ordered
+type pair is `directLdBranchRejectionProbability`. -/
+def directRejectedMass (D : DirectLdParams) (S : Strategy (directLdGame D))
+    (x y : DirectLdQuestion D) : ℝ :=
+  ∑ a : DirectLdAnswer D, ∑ b : DirectLdAnswer D,
+    if directLdWinPredicate D x y a b then 0 else outcomeWeight S x y a b
+
+theorem directRejectedMass_nonneg (D : DirectLdParams)
+    (S : Strategy (directLdGame D)) (x y : DirectLdQuestion D) :
+    0 ≤ directRejectedMass D S x y := by
+  refine Finset.sum_nonneg fun a _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun b _ => ?_
+  split_ifs
+  · exact le_rfl
+  · exact outcomeWeight_nonneg S x y a b
+
+/-- The branch rejection probability of an ordered type pair is the uniform
+average of the rejected Born mass at the canonical questions of the common
+direct sample. -/
+theorem directLdBranchRejectionProbability_eq_avgOver (D : DirectLdParams)
+    (S : Strategy (directLdGame D)) (types : LdType × LdType) :
+    directLdBranchRejectionProbability D S types =
+      avgOver (uniformDistribution (DirectLdSpace D)) fun sample =>
+        directRejectedMass D S
+          (types.1, directLdMap D types.1 sample)
+          (types.2, directLdMap D types.2 sample) :=
+  rfl
+
+/-- When every accepted direct answer pair reads out to equal mature answers,
+the bipartite consistency defect of the two readouts at a fixed question pair
+is at most the rejected direct Born mass there.  The matched mass of the
+readouts is the Born mass of the pairs with equal readouts, and the total
+overlap is the full Born mass, which is one. -/
+theorem qBipartiteConsDefect_le_directRejectedMass
+    (D : DirectLdParams) (S : Strategy (directLdGame D))
+    (hS : S.IsProjective)
+    {Outcome : Type*} [Fintype Outcome]
+    (x y : DirectLdQuestion D)
+    (readA readB : DirectLdAnswer D → Outcome)
+    (hwin : ∀ a b, directLdWinPredicate D x y a b = true → readA a = readB b) :
+    qBipartiteConsDefect (strategyQuantumState S)
+        (ProjMeas.postprocess
+          (matrixMeasurementToLDTProjMeas (S.A x) (hS.1 x)) readA).toSubMeas
+        (ProjMeas.postprocess
+          (matrixMeasurementToLDTProjMeas (S.B y) (hS.2 y)) readB).toSubMeas ≤
+      directRejectedMass D S x y := by
+  classical
+  have hmatch :
+      qBipartiteMatchMass (strategyQuantumState S)
+          (ProjMeas.postprocess
+            (matrixMeasurementToLDTProjMeas (S.A x) (hS.1 x)) readA).toSubMeas
+          (ProjMeas.postprocess
+            (matrixMeasurementToLDTProjMeas (S.B y) (hS.2 y)) readB).toSubMeas =
+        ∑ a : DirectLdAnswer D, ∑ b : DirectLdAnswer D,
+          if readA a = readB b then outcomeWeight S x y a b else 0 := by
+    unfold qBipartiteMatchMass
+    calc

+          (opTensor
+            ((ProjMeas.postprocess
+              (matrixMeasurementToLDTProjMeas (S.A x) (hS.1 x)) readA).outcome c)
+            ((ProjMeas.postprocess
+              (matrixMeasurementToLDTProjMeas (S.B y) (hS.2 y)) readB).outcome c)) =
+          ∑ c : Outcome,
+            ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun a => readA a = c),
+              ∑ b ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun b => readB b = c),
+                outcomeWeight S x y a b := by
+        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
+        intro c _
+        exact directPostprocessBornWeight D S hS x y readA readB c c
+      _ = ∑ c : Outcome, ∑ a : DirectLdAnswer D,
+            if readA a = c then
+              ∑ b : DirectLdAnswer D,
+                if readB b = c then outcomeWeight S x y a b else 0
+            else 0 := by
+        simp only [Finset.sum_filter]
+      _ = ∑ a : DirectLdAnswer D, ∑ c : Outcome,
+            if readA a = c then
+              ∑ b : DirectLdAnswer D,
+                if readB b = c then outcomeWeight S x y a b else 0
+            else 0 := Finset.sum_comm
+      _ = ∑ a : DirectLdAnswer D, ∑ b : DirectLdAnswer D,
+            if readA a = readB b then outcomeWeight S x y a b else 0 := by
+        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
+        intro a _
+        rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq]
+        simp only [Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
+        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
+        intro b _
+        by_cases hab : readA a = readB b
+        · simp [hab]
+        · have hba : ¬ readB b = readA a := fun h => hab h.symm
+          simp [hab, hba]
+  have hone : ∑ a : DirectLdAnswer D, ∑ b : DirectLdAnswer D,
+      outcomeWeight S x y a b = 1 :=
+    outcomeWeight_sum_eq_one S x y
+  have htotal :
+      ev (strategyQuantumState S)
+        (opTensor
+          (ProjMeas.postprocess
+            (matrixMeasurementToLDTProjMeas (S.A x) (hS.1 x)) readA).toSubMeas.total
+          (ProjMeas.postprocess
+            (matrixMeasurementToLDTProjMeas (S.B y) (hS.2 y)) readB).toSubMeas.total) =
+        1 := by
+    change ev (strategyQuantumState S)
+      (Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun x1 x2 => x1 * x2) (1 : Op S.ιA) (1 : Op S.ιB)) = 1
+    rw [Matrix.one_kronecker_one]
+    exact ev_one_of_isNormalized _ (strategyQuantumState_isNormalized S)
+  simp only [qBipartiteConsDefect]
+  refine max_le (directRejectedMass_nonneg D S x y) ?_
+  rw [htotal, hmatch, ← hone, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
+  unfold directRejectedMass
+  refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun a _ => ?_
+  rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
+  refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun b _ => ?_
+  have hw := outcomeWeight_nonneg S x y a b
+  by_cases hacc : directLdWinPredicate D x y a b = true
+  · have hread := hwin a b hacc
+    simp [hacc, hread]
+  · rw [if_neg hacc]
+    split_ifs <;> linarith
+
+/-! ## Accepted answer pairs read out consistently
+
+An accepted answer pair of the direct game consists of well-formed answers
+satisfying the line-versus-point clause or the consistency clause of
+`def:ld-win-predicate`.  The readouts of `Transport.Questions` evaluate the
+rebased line polynomial at the mature base point, which is the direct point
+at the canonical rebase parameter; the accepted clause forces this value to
+be the point answer.  Zero directions use the constant readout at the base
+point, where the universal clause of `rem:ld-win-zero-direction` gives the
+value at parameter zero. -/
+
+/-- On the point-agreement branch, an accepted pair of point answers has
+equal readouts in every simultaneous coordinate. -/
+theorem directPointAnswerReadout_eq_of_win (D : DirectLdParams) (r : Fin D.k)
+    (p : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) (a b : DirectLdAnswer D)
+    (hwin : directLdWinPredicate D (directLdPointQuestionOf D p)
+      (directLdPointQuestionOf D p) a b = true) :
+    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
+    directPointAnswerReadout D r a = directPointAnswerReadout D r b := by
+  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
+  cases a with
+  | pointVals u =>
+      cases b with
+      | pointVals v =>
+          have huv : u = v := by
+            simpa [directLdWinPredicate, directLdPointQuestionOf,
+              validDirectLdAnswer] using hwin
+          subst huv
+          rfl
+      | alinePolys _ =>
+          simp [directLdWinPredicate, directLdPointQuestionOf,
+            validDirectLdAnswer] at hwin
+      | dlinePolys _ =>
+          simp [directLdWinPredicate, directLdPointQuestionOf,
+            validDirectLdAnswer] at hwin
+  | alinePolys _ =>
+      simp [directLdWinPredicate, directLdPointQuestionOf,
+        validDirectLdAnswer] at hwin
+  | dlinePolys _ =>
+      simp [directLdWinPredicate, directLdPointQuestionOf,
+        validDirectLdAnswer] at hwin
+
+/-- The axis-line acceptance clause at the canonical rebase parameter gives
+the rebased polynomial its point value at the mature base point. -/
+private theorem axis_readout_of_condition (D : DirectLdParams) (r : Fin D.k)
+    (line : AxisParallelLine D.toLDTParameters)
+    (f : Fin D.k → Fin (D.d + 1) → DirectScalarQ D)
+    (c : Fin D.k → DirectScalarQ D)
+    (hcond : directAlinePointCondition D
+      ⟨lineRepMap (coordinateDirection (Fin.rev line.direction))
+          (ldtPointToDirect D line.base),
+        Fin.rev line.direction, 0⟩
+      ⟨ldtPointToDirect D line.base, D.firstIndex, 0⟩ f c) :
+    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
+    directAxisAnswerReadout D r line (.alinePolys f) zeroCoord =
+      directScalarEquiv D (c r) := by
+  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
+  have heval : evalCoefficient (f r) (directAxisRebaseParameter D line) = c r :=
+    hcond (directAxisRebaseParameter D line)
+      (directLineRepParameter_spec
+        (coordinateDirection (Fin.rev line.direction))
+        (ldtPointToDirect D line.base)) r
+  simp only [directAxisAnswerReadout]
+  rw [AxisLinePolynomial.reparamAt_apply_zero, directAxisAnswerEquiv_apply, heval]
+
+/-- The diagonal-line acceptance clause gives the readout its point value at
+the mature base point, using the canonical rebase parameter for a nonzero
+direction and the parameter zero for the zero direction. -/
+private theorem diagonal_readout_of_condition (D : DirectLdParams) (r : Fin D.k)
+    (line : DiagonalLine D.toLDTParameters)
+    (f : Fin D.k → Fin (D.m * D.d + 1) → DirectScalarQ D)
+    (c : Fin D.k → DirectScalarQ D)
+    (hcond : directDlinePointCondition D
+      ⟨lineRepMap (ldtPointToDirect D line.direction) (ldtPointToDirect D line.base),
+        directDiagonalIndexOf D (ldtPointToDirect D line.direction),
+        ldtPointToDirect D line.direction⟩
+      ⟨ldtPointToDirect D line.base, D.firstIndex, 0⟩ f c) :
+    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
+    directDiagonalAnswerReadout D r line (.dlinePolys f) zeroCoord =
+      directScalarEquiv D (c r) := by
+  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
+  by_cases hdir : ldtPointToDirect D line.direction = 0
+  · have hbase : ldtPointToDirect D line.base =
+        lineRepMap (0 : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) (ldtPointToDirect D line.base) := by
+      have hspec := directLineRepParameter_spec
+        (ldtPointToDirect D line.direction) (ldtPointToDirect D line.base)
+      rwa [hdir, smul_zero, add_zero] at hspec
+    rw [hdir] at hcond
+    have heval : evalCoefficient (f r) 0 = c r := by
+      refine hcond 0 ?_ r
+      change ldtPointToDirect D line.base =
+        lineRepMap (0 : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) (ldtPointToDirect D line.base) +
+          (0 : DirectScalarQ D) • (0 : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D)
+      rw [smul_zero, add_zero]
+      exact hbase
+    simp only [directDiagonalAnswerReadout, hdir, if_true]
+    rw [constantDiagonalAnswer_apply, heval]
+  · have heval :
+        evalCoefficient (f r) (directDiagonalRebaseParameter D line) = c r :=
+      hcond (directDiagonalRebaseParameter D line)
+        (directLineRepParameter_spec
+          (ldtPointToDirect D line.direction) (ldtPointToDirect D line.base)) r
+    simp only [directDiagonalAnswerReadout, hdir, if_false]
+    rw [DiagonalLinePolynomial.reparamAt_apply_zero,
+      directDiagonalAnswerEquiv_apply, heval]
+
+/-- On the axis-line branch with the line on the left, an accepted direct
+answer pair has the rebased line answer, evaluated at the mature base point,
+equal to the point readout. -/
+theorem directAxisAnswerReadout_zeroCoord_eq_of_win (D : DirectLdParams)
+    (r : Fin D.k) (line : AxisParallelLine D.toLDTParameters)
+    (a b : DirectLdAnswer D)
+    (hwin : directLdWinPredicate D (directAxisQuestionOf D line)
+      (directPointQuestionOf D line.base) a b = true) :
+    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
+    directAxisAnswerReadout D r line a zeroCoord =
+      directPointAnswerReadout D r b := by
+  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
+  cases a with
+  | alinePolys f =>
+      cases b with
+      | pointVals c =>
+          refine axis_readout_of_condition D r line f c ?_
+          simpa [directLdWinPredicate, directAxisQuestionOf, directPointQuestionOf,
+            directLdPointQuestionOf, validDirectLdAnswer] using hwin
+      | alinePolys _ =>
+          simp [directLdWinPredicate, directAxisQuestionOf, directPointQuestionOf,
+            directLdPointQuestionOf, validDirectLdAnswer] at hwin
+      | dlinePolys _ =>
+          simp [directLdWinPredicate, directAxisQuestionOf, directPointQuestionOf,
+            directLdPointQuestionOf, validDirectLdAnswer] at hwin
+  | pointVals _ =>
+      simp [directLdWinPredicate, directAxisQuestionOf, directPointQuestionOf,
+        directLdPointQuestionOf, validDirectLdAnswer] at hwin
+  | dlinePolys _ =>
+      simp [directLdWinPredicate, directAxisQuestionOf, directPointQuestionOf,
+        directLdPointQuestionOf, validDirectLdAnswer] at hwin
+
+/-- On the axis-line branch with the point on the left, an accepted direct
+answer pair has the point readout equal to the rebased line answer evaluated
+at the mature base point. -/
+theorem directPointAnswerReadout_eq_axis_zeroCoord_of_win (D : DirectLdParams)
+    (r : Fin D.k) (line : AxisParallelLine D.toLDTParameters)
+    (a b : DirectLdAnswer D)
+    (hwin : directLdWinPredicate D (directPointQuestionOf D line.base)
+      (directAxisQuestionOf D line) a b = true) :
+    letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
+    directPointAnswerReadout D r a =
+      directAxisAnswerReadout D r line b zeroCoord := by
+  letI := D.toLDTFieldModel
+  cases a with
+  | pointVals c =>
+      cases b with
+      | alinePolys f =>
+          refine (axis_readout_of_condition D r line f c ?_).symm
+          simpa [directLdWinPredicate, directAxisQuestionOf, directPointQuestionOf,
+            directLdPointQuestionOf, validDirectLdAnswer] using hwin
+      | pointVals _ =>
+          simp [directLdWinPredicate, directAxisQuestionOf, directPointQuestionOf,
+            directLdPointQuestionOf, validDirectLdAnswer] at hwin
+      | dlinePolys _ =>
+          simp [directLdWinPredicate, directAxisQuestionOf, directPointQuestionOf,
+            directLdPointQuestionOf, validDirectLdAnswer] at hwin
+  | alinePolys _ =>
+      simp [directLdWinPredicate, directAxisQuestionOf, directPointQuestionOf,
+        directLdPointQuestionOf, validDirectLdAnswer] at hwin
+  | dlinePolys _ =>
+      simp [directLdWinPredicate, directAxisQuestionOf, directPointQuestionOf,
+        directLdPointQuestionOf, validDirectLdAnswer] at hwin
+
+/-- On the diagonal-line branch with the line on the left, an accepted direct
+answer pair has the rebased line answer, evaluated at the mature base point,
+equal to the point readout. -/
+theorem directDiagonalAnswerReadout_zeroCoord_eq_of_win (D : DirectLdParams)

+  | dlinePolys f =>

+          refine diagonal_readout_of_condition D r line f c ?_

+            directPointQuestionOf, directLdPointQuestionOf,
+            validDirectLdAnswer] using hwin
+      | alinePolys _ =>
+          simp [directLdWinPredicate, directDiagonalQuestionOf, directPointQuestionOf,

+      | dlinePolys _ =>
+          simp [directLdWinPredicate, directDiagonalQuestionOf, directPointQuestionOf,

+  | pointVals _ =>
+      simp [directLdWinPredicate, directDiagonalQuestionOf, directPointQuestionOf,

+/-- On the diagonal-line branch with the point on the left, an accepted

+theorem directPointAnswerReadout_eq_diagonal_zeroCoord_of_win (D : DirectLdParams)

+            validDirectLdAnswer] using hwin

+  | alinePolys _ =>
